• Strong video editing and creative strategy skills



• Experience working with AliExpress or similar physical products



• Strong understanding of hooks, angles, buyer psychology, direct response, and retention



• Strong product, competitor, and content research skills



• Able to create complete ads independently from only a product link



• Able to adapt your creative approach to different products, audiences, and niches instead of using the same style for every product



• Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Kling, Veo, Runway, ElevenLabs, or similar



• Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar





To Apply:



1-Send your portfolio and your best e-commerce product ads.



Please include examples from different product categories or niches. For example, do not send only beauty ads, only gadget ads, or only one type of product. We want to see that you can create strong video ads for different types of e-commerce products.



2-Send at least 3 strong examples from different niches or product categories whenever possible. For example, one home product, one beauty or wellness product, and one gadget or outdoor product.



3-For each example, explain exactly what you personally did: product research, competitor research, angle, hook, script, content sourcing, AI generation, and editing. Also mention what was provided by the client.



4-If available, send the original AliExpress or supplier link for these examples so we can compare the original product with your finished ad.



5-If we give you only an AliExpress product link, explain your process for turning it into a finished high-converting video ad.



6-Approximately how long does it take you to create one complete video ad from start to finish, including research, strategy, scriptwriting, content sourcing or AI generation, and final editing?



7-How do you research competitors, customer pain points, hooks, angles, and existing winning ads?



8-Which AI and video editing tools do you currently use?



9-Have you worked with metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, and retention? If yes, how do you use this data to improve creatives?



10-How many hours per week are you available?

title: Basic Headline Editor
description:
Basic Headline Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $5 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brand. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new product lines launching soon. Our content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators works fully remotely across the world.

This role is a starting point, and we're straight about that — it's focused work editing headline videos to a proven format. But it's a starting point on a team that promotes from the inside. Many of our editors have been with us two or more years, and the ones who started here are now the people briefing everyone else.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

AI Advanced Editor.

That's the next title, and it's the step most of our strong headline editors make inside their first six months. An AI Advanced Editor works on our highest-leverage creative: AI-assisted video, hook development, and the ad formats we scale behind. You stop working purely to a template and start building the ones other people follow.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $5 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning creative — when a video you cut hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within three to six months, you're consistently producing headline videos that perform on both paid and organic channels — 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing day-to-day direction.

Responsibilities

Edit TikTok and Reels headline content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time

Review past edits daily, identify what is and isn't working, and apply those lessons

Work with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on proven formats

Turn work around quickly and communicate proactively each day

Track TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant

Requirements

A recent portfolio of short-form edits (ideally 20+ from the past few months)

Ability to break down why a viral video or high-performing ad worked

Comfortable reading performance metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time) and adjusting accordingly

Skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to work independently

Takes ownership and applies feedback consistently

Preferred

Experience editing for e-commerce brands

Exposure to AI video tools, talking heads, or voiceover formats

Experience interpreting paid ad metrics

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing roles teach you software. This one teaches you why things sell. You'll get direct access to paid ad data on real spend, see which of your creatives print money and which die, and build the one skill that makes editors expensive: knowing what to make before you make it.

Access to courses and paid software

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Full visibility into TikTok and Meta performance data on your own work

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You prefer a fixed schedule or close day-to-day supervision

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Independent contractor engagement, paid in USD

100% remote, approximately 40 hours per week, long-term

Flexible schedule with no required timezone overlap — async communication daily

Flexible paid time off, coordinated with the team

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), TikTok and Meta analytics

No micromanagement

How to Apply

Applications take about five minutes. We review every submission.

title: Expert Performance Video Editor
description:
Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.

This role is video, end to end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.

We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.

You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.

That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.

It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.

Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.

What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.

Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.

Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed

You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.

title: Performance Video Editor  | 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Performance Video Editor | 8-Figure DTC Brand



HaloBlinds is a fast-growing 8-figure DTC brand looking for talented video editors who understand performance creative, paid social, and what actually makes ads scale.



This is a freelance role where you are paid per video, with significant performance bonuses when your creatives become winners.



Create ads that drive real revenue. Turn raw UGC and product footage into high-performing paid social creatives. If your ads perform and we scale serious ad spend behind them, you earn more.



We are not looking for editors who only know how to make videos look good.



We are looking for editors who understand how to make ads perform.



You should understand hooks, pacing, retention, UGC, storytelling, direct response, creative angles, and how to turn raw footage into Meta ads that can scale.



What you'll do:



- Edit performance-focused Meta ads

- Turn raw UGC and product footage into direct-response creatives

- Create different hooks, intros, structures and variations

- Iterate on proven winning concepts

- Test new angles and editing styles

- Work from scripts, briefs and creative concepts provided by our team

- Use performance data to understand what is working and improve future edits



Compensation:



You will be paid per completed video.



On top of your normal video rate, we offer strong performance bonuses based on the ad spend generated by your creatives.



If you create a winning ad and we are able to scale significant spend behind it, you will earn additional bonuses.



The more successful creatives you produce, the more you can earn.



We want editors to have a real incentive to create ads that perform, not simply finish another edit.



Who we're looking for



You should ideally have:



- Experience editing paid social ads

- Experience with DTC or e-commerce brands

- A strong understanding of Meta creative

- Experience with UGC and direct-response advertising

- A good understanding of hooks and viewer retention

- The ability to edit quickly and test multiple variations

- A performance mindset and interest in what happens after an ad goes live

title: Junior AI Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week · $3- $6 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses



About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing travel jewelry brand selling collectible travel charms. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram, and we're now scaling our image ad creatives to match.



You'll join a lean, fully remote international team of designers, video editors, and content creators, working closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. This role exists because our image ad output needs to catch up with our video engine, and you'll help build that side of the creative machine.



That's the opportunity: you're not joining a mature department to take instructions. You're building the static side of a content operation that has already proved it can do a quarter billion views.



Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Designer.



That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. A Senior Designer here owns the visual direction of our image ads: you test your own concepts rather than executing briefs, you expand our prompt library, and you set the standard the rest of the team designs to.



It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.



What You'll Earn

Base: $5 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning ad. When a creative you made hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it.

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within 1–2 weeks, a successful hire is producing 10/10-quality AI image ads by following our process, creating work that passes review without rework and matches the Exchange Life look. From there, success means consistent output, images that perform on ads, and proactive suggestions that improve the process itself.



Core Responsibilities

Generate AI product images using our internal prompts, templates, and workflows

Overlay headlines and copy in Photoshop, matching Exchange Life's visual style

Iterate on designs based on feedback from the team and ad performance

Organize and manage creative assets, keeping our AI image library clean and up to date

Communicate proactively about bottlenecks, capacity, and output

Must-Haves

Intermediate Adobe Photoshop skills (this is your main tool)

Solid grasp of text placement and typography for ad creatives

A portfolio showing clean, polished design work

Able to follow a creative brief and established process independently

Reliable communicator who shares their opinion and flags issues early

Clear written and spoken English

Stable internet connection

Nice-to-Haves

AI image generation experience (Higgsfield or similar tools)

Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or social media ad creative

What You'll Learn Here

AI creative is the fastest-moving skill in marketing right now, and most designers are learning it on personal projects with no feedback loop. You'll learn it on real ad spend.

title: Community & Operations VA
description:
About The AYCI Academy

The AYCI Academy is the UK's leading coaching programme for NHS doctors preparing for senior consultant job interviews. Founded by Dr Tessa Davis, a paediatric emergency physician, we run five cohorts a year and have helped thousands of doctors secure their first consultant post. We're a small, remote team that operates a tightly structured programme - documented processes, clear ownership, high standards.





The Role

This role is the operational backbone of the AYCI Academy's delivery infrastructure. You'll own the backend systems that keep each cohort running reliably - Circle (our Community Platform) administration, cohort scheduling, 1:1 call logistics, automation monitoring, and the student wins system.



This is not a community management role in the traditional sense. You won't be managing student relationships or driving engagement - that sits with our Student Success Manager. What you'll own is verything behind the scenes: the platform admin, the scheduling, the automations, and the operational accuracy that makes the student-facing experience work.



The standard is simple: nothing slips, nothing needs a follow-up, and our Founder never has to step in because something in this lane was missed.



The role is 15 hours per week at $15/hour. This should include a few hours each day and at least half of these should be during UK hours (can be UK afternoons/evenings)



What You'll Own:

These are the 5 primary areas of work: 



1: Circle Community Administration

You'll own the full backend of our Circle community - setting up cohort spaces, managing access and permissions, uploading recordings, keeping the leaderboard current, and archiving at cohort close. Everything students see in Circle runs through this role.



2: Cohort Scheduling & Logistics

You'll build and maintain the cohort calendar at least a month out - sessions, guest speakers, coaching assignments, and the kickoff sequence. Coaches have what they need before every session. Nothing conflicts with the launch schedule.



3: 1:1 Booking & Call Coordination

End-to-end ownership of all private tier and bonus call bookings. You'll maintain a forward-looking availability calendar and coordinate with coaches to ensure slots always exist before any student is pointed toward a booking link. No booking link goes out without confirmed availability - this is a hard rule.



4: Automation & Systems Monitoring

You'll monitor all active automations in Zapier and Make, own the interview dates system, and keep Kit (ConvertKit) tags and flows running correctly. When something breaks, you catch and fix it. You don't wait to be told.



5: Student Wins System

When a student win comes in through our Student Success Manager, you ensure the backend fires correctly: the right Kit tags, the Boss badge in Circle, automation exclusions, and the testimonial call flow. The wins system is the single source of truth - every win captured, no gaps.





What We're Looking For

- Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through - the kind of person who closes tasks before being asked

- Comfortable working independently in Circle, 
, Zapier/Make, Kajabi, and Kit (ConvertKit) - you don't need to build systems from scratch, but you need to own and maintain them

- Self-directed and high-autonomy - you manage your own board, flag problems early, and don't need daily check-ins

- Clear written English for internal coordination with a small remote team

- Experience supporting a remote online education or membership business is a plus, but not required



This role is not a good fit if you want to work directly with students, prefer flexible undefined scope, or need close direction. We operate with high autonomy and high accountability in equal measure.





How to Apply

- Send your CV and a short Loom (under 3 minutes) covering two things:

1: Why you are the best candidate for this position 

2: One example of a backend operations or admin system you own - what it involves and how you keep it running



We need to know you can do the job.

Pipeline hygiene: Keep lead and opportunity records accurate, current, and free of duplicates. Move or close out stalled deals so the pipeline shows only real opportunities.



Lead routing: Make sure leads coming out of SDR Pitch Review calls are routed correctly. A leads go to downsell or nurture, B leads are booked with a closer, and C leads go into objection-handling sequences.

Dashboards and reporting: Maintain the sales dashboards and leaderboards, including the Q4 Sales vs. Marketing competition. Prepare weekly performance reports for the Friday team wrap.

Integrations: Keep an eye on the Clarity Pay and Stripe connections and escalate payment or sync issues quickly.



Team support: Answer everyday "how do I…" questions from the sales team, write short how-to guides, and help onboard new SDRs to Close.

title: Job Title: Operations & Systems Manager
description:
Job Title: Operations & Systems Manager

Salary: ₱30,000 – ₱45,000 / month



Employment Type: Full-time



Location: Remote (Philippine Standard Time working hours)



About the Role

We are looking for an Operations & Systems Manager to own day-to-day execution across people, processes, systems, and technology.



In this role, you will be the first point of contact for work-related and system problems—ensuring issues are investigated, resolved, delegated, automated, or escalated appropriately before reaching Leadership. This is a multi-hat position for an operations-minded problem solver who knows how to connect the pieces between project management, CRMs, automations, and team execution to keep the entire system running smoothly.



What Success Looks Like

Problems are identified, investigated, and solved before reaching Leadership. You understand operational and technical blockers, determine the required actions, assign the right team members, and follow tasks through to resolution.



Key Responsibilities

* Operations Management: Keep projects, deliverables, and weekly priorities moving smoothly across Sales, Marketing,    Operations, and IT.

* Process Optimization: Identify bottlenecks, simplify workflows, refine SOPs, and eliminate unnecessary manual work.

* Systems Management: Oversee how CRM, payments, automations, communication tools, and internal systems connect and flow together.

* Technical Coordination: Translate business and operational problems into clear technical requirements and briefs for developers and automation specialists.

* Team Management: Run 1:1 meetings, track team performance, coach underperformance, and hold staff accountable to key deliverables.

* Problem Resolution: Act as the first line of defense to troubleshoot operational or technical issues before escalating to Leadership.

* SOP & Quality Control: Ensure established processes for payments, invoicing, commissions, sourcing, and onboarding are strictly followed.

* Hiring & Onboarding: Support final candidate interviews for specialist roles and manage end-to-end onboarding for new hires.



Technical & Core Requirements

*  CRM Operations: Daily working experience inside CRMs (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar)—managing contacts, pipelines, tags, custom fields, and smart lists, as well as troubleshooting data discrepancies.

* Automation Logic: Ability to read and understand workflows in GoHighLevel, Make, Zapier, or n8n (triggers, actions, filters, conditions) and identify where a flow broke using run history.

* Integration Fundamentals: Solid grasp of how platforms exchange data (webhooks, API connections, field mapping) and why records fail to sync (e.g.,
 mismatches across Shopify and CRM).

* Workflow Mapping: Proven ability to turn complex or messy processes into clear, step-by-step workflow maps to identify gaps, redundancies, and handoff failures.

* Technical Brief Writing: Ability to write clear requirement briefs for technical builders (trigger, expected outcome, test cases, owners) without requiring back-and-forth alignment calls.

* Project Management Tools: Hands-on experience building and managing task boards, deadlines, and team assignments in ClickUp or similar platforms.

* Spreadsheets & Documentation: Working knowledge of Google Sheets / Excel for tracking and data management, alongside strong SOP writing skills.

* AI Tool Integration: Daily use of ChatGPT or Claude for drafting SOPs, summarizing information, cleaning data, and troubleshooting (with strict quality checks on outputs).

* Remote Collaboration: Fully comfortable working via Slack, Google Workspace, Loom, and video calls.



Nice-to-Have Experience

* Background as an Operations Manager / Coordinator, Project Manager / Coordinator, or Executive Assistant.

* Experience as a CRM Administrator / GoHighLevel Virtual Assistant.

* Background in HR Admin, Talent Acquisition, or onboarding support.

* Experience as a Team Lead or Supervisor managing remote teams.

* Startup or agency operations background.

* Experience or interest in the sports, athletic development, or coaching industry.



Tools Used in This Role

You do not need to be an expert in every tool on day one, but you should be capable of learning new systems quickly and understanding how they connect:



* CRM: GoHighLevel (GHL)

* Automation: GHL + Make

* Payments & Web: Shopify + GHL

* Lead Capture: iClosed + GHL

* Project Management: ClickUp

* Client / User Communication: WhatsApp, 

* Marketing & Creatives: Meta Business Suite, Canva, CapCut

* App / Service Operations: MyPTHub

* AI & Automation Tools: ChatGPT, Claude

* Workspace & Comms: Google Workspace, Google Drive, Slack

title: Performance Manager — Meta Ads & Onboarding (Remote)
description:
⚠️ IMPORTANT — READ FIRST Applying on this platform does NOT count as an application. To be considered, you must apply here: 👉 
 



Applications without a video submission will not be considered.



About Social Hotspot

We're a UK-based growth agency helping trades businesses — bathrooms, kitchens, windows — generate qualified leads and book appointments through a done-for-you marketing system called GrowthSuite.



We've generated £25M+ for our partners. We're trusted by 80+ active businesses. And we're on a mission to hit £100M in sales for UK trades businesses. We're growing fast and we need the right people to grow with us.

About The Role

This is not a senior media buyer role with a nicer title.



You own the performance of every ad account we run — around 120 accounts across three client pods — through a team of three Media Buyers and three Onboarding VAs, and you report directly to our founder. Two numbers sit above everything else on your scorecard: total churn and average client satisfaction score. Everything else in the role exists to move those two numbers.



The standard here: you should know the ad accounts better than the media buyers do. That comes from inspecting the actual work — accounts, builds, tickets — twice a week, every week. Not from reading a report at month end.



Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00–17:30 (UK time). Fully remote, full-time.

What You'll Be Doing

Running two full passes of every ad account each week — worst client score first, with red accounts taken apart line by line: copy, headline, targeting, offer, landing page, survey

Checking every client onboarding build within a day of completion — the media buyer's campaign setup and the VA's GoHighLevel build — looking for mistakes, not ticked boxes

Logging every finding with one clear change, and checking at the next pass that the change actually happened

Running weekly ad account coaching calls and weekly 1:1s with each media buyer, and weekly 1:1s with each VA

Sweeping every internal support channel and client WhatsApp group twice a week — and re-testing "resolved" issues yourself

Running a post-mortem within 48 hours on every account that churns or stays red for 30 days

Owning the at-risk list, attending the twice-weekly red flag meeting, and running weekly and monthly reviews with the founder

Grading your team monthly and running their bonus process

Hiring, onboarding, and — when it's the right call — exiting media buyers and VAs

Owning every media buyer and VA SOP, their ramp-up courses and the GoHighLevel course, on a rolling three-month audit

What You Must Be Strong At

Meta ads diagnosis — you can open an account you've never seen and find what's wrong in minutes

Coaching — getting a buyer to see the problem themselves, landing one change, and following up until the behaviour changes

Attention to detail at volume — 120 accounts, six people, every build checked, nothing skipped

GoHighLevel — landing pages, forms, automations, custom values and AI bots, well enough to catch someone else's mistakes

Commercial awareness — you understand lead quality, show rates and churn, not just CPL

Composure delivering hard news — to your team, and upward to the founder

Accountability — you own the team's numbers like they're your own business

Compensation

£3,250/month base salary (£39,000/year, approx. $4,300/month), plus monthly bonuses:



£250/month when total churn is 5% or under

£250/month when average client satisfaction score is 8.1+

£100/month when every client in their first 90 days is on pace to 45+ appointments

£15 for every ad account that was in the red zone at the end of last month and is out of it at the end of this month



No bonus is paid in any month where your own overall grade falls below a B — the account passes, the build checks and the 1:1s are the price of entry to the variable, not optional extras.



On-target earnings: roughly £45,500–£49,000 a year.

Your KPIs

Total churn — A grade: under 3%

Average client satisfaction score — A grade: 8.1+/10

% of clients in RED on CPL — A grade: 0–5%

Clients in their first 90 days on pace to 45+ appointments — A grade: every client on pace

Onboarding SOPs completed on time (team) — A grade: all

Onboarding accuracy, revisions required (team) — A grade: 0–2/month

IT issues resolved on time (team) — A grade: 95%+

Ad tracker and R&D compliance (team) — A grade: all buyers hit both

Ad account passes completed — A grade: all 8 in the month

Grading accuracy vs the founder's spot-check — A grade: no disagreements

Cadence delivered on time (1:1s, ad account calls, red flags, scorecards) — A grade: all on time

SOP revisions cleared in the month due — A grade: all

Ramp-ups passed on schedule — A grade: all at 90%+, on time

Documented mistakes (all types) — A grade: 0–2/month



Requirements

Fluent English (written and spoken)

5+ years running Meta ads, with $500,000+ in proven ad spend managed

Local lead generation experience — home improvement strongly preferred

Agency experience managing a multi-client portfolio

Experience checking, training or managing other media buyers' work

Hands-on GoHighLevel — funnels, forms, automations

Comfortable with 
 (or similar), Google Sheets and dashboards

Available 9:00–17:30 UK time, Monday to Friday

Full-time and exclusive — no other clients, agencies or side projects



Bonus Skills

A formal team lead or management role over media buyers

Experience running a grading or bonus scheme

Power BI

Writing SOPs or training material



Who This Is For



Someone who's the best media buyer in the room and wants to make everyone else in it better. Someone who'd rather find the red account on Monday morning than hear about it from a client on Friday. Someone who can tell a colleague their work isn't good enough — and check the next week that it changed. Someone who wants to own the numbers, not just their own accounts.



Who This Is NOT For

Anyone who manages from a dashboard instead of opening the accounts. Anyone who quietly fixes other people's mistakes instead of telling them. Anyone who avoids hard conversations. Freelancers juggling other clients. Anyone who needs to be told what "good" looks like instead of building the standard themselves.

Who you are, the ad spend you've managed and the results you've got

title: Media Buyer Manager
description:
PM - Job Post

Performance Manager — Meta Ads & Onboarding (Remote)

⚠️ IMPORTANT — READ FIRST Applying on this platform does NOT count as an application. To be considered, you must apply here: 👉 
 Applications without a video submission will not be considered.

About Social Hotspot

We're a UK-based growth agency helping trades businesses — bathrooms, kitchens, windows — generate qualified leads and book appointments through a done-for-you marketing system called GrowthSuite.



We've generated £25M+ for our partners. We're trusted by 80+ active businesses. And we're on a mission to hit £100M in sales for UK trades businesses. We're growing fast and we need the right people to grow with us.

About The Role

This is not a senior media buyer role with a nicer title.



You own the performance of every ad account we run — around 120 accounts across three client pods — through a team of three Media Buyers and three Onboarding VAs, and you report directly to our founder. Two numbers sit above everything else on your scorecard: total churn and average client satisfaction score. Everything else in the role exists to move those two numbers.



The standard here: you should know the ad accounts better than the media buyers do. That comes from inspecting the actual work — accounts, builds, tickets — twice a week, every week. Not from reading a report at month end.



Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00–17:30 (UK time). Fully remote, full-time.

What You'll Be Doing

Running two full passes of every ad account each week — worst client score first, with red accounts taken apart line by line: copy, headline, targeting, offer, landing page, survey

Checking every client onboarding build within a day of completion — the media buyer's campaign setup and the VA's GoHighLevel build — looking for mistakes, not ticked boxes

Logging every finding with one clear change, and checking at the next pass that the change actually happened

Running weekly ad account coaching calls and weekly 1:1s with each media buyer, and weekly 1:1s with each VA

Sweeping every internal support channel and client WhatsApp group twice a week — and re-testing "resolved" issues yourself

Running a post-mortem within 48 hours on every account that churns or stays red for 30 days

Owning the at-risk list, attending the twice-weekly red flag meeting, and running weekly and monthly reviews with the founder

Grading your team monthly and running their bonus process

Hiring, onboarding, and — when it's the right call — exiting media buyers and VAs

Owning every media buyer and VA SOP, their ramp-up courses and the GoHighLevel course, on a rolling three-month audit

What You Must Be Strong At

Meta ads diagnosis — you can open an account you've never seen and find what's wrong in minutes

Coaching — getting a buyer to see the problem themselves, landing one change, and following up until the behaviour changes

Attention to detail at volume — 120 accounts, six people, every build checked, nothing skipped

GoHighLevel — landing pages, forms, automations, custom values and AI bots, well enough to catch someone else's mistakes

Commercial awareness — you understand lead quality, show rates and churn, not just CPL

Composure delivering hard news — to your team, and upward to the founder

Accountability — you own the team's numbers like they're your own business

Compensation

£3,250/month base salary (£39,000/year, approx. $4,300/month), plus monthly bonuses:



£250/month when total churn is 5% or under

£250/month when average client satisfaction score is 8.1+

£100/month when every client in their first 90 days is on pace to 45+ appointments

£15 for every ad account that was in the red zone at the end of last month and is out of it at the end of this month



No bonus is paid in any month where your own overall grade falls below a B — the account passes, the build checks and the 1:1s are the price of entry to the variable, not optional extras.



On-target earnings: roughly £45,500–£49,000 a year.

Your KPIs

Total churn — A grade: under 3%

Average client satisfaction score — A grade: 8.1+/10

% of clients in RED on CPL — A grade: 0–5%

Clients in their first 90 days on pace to 45+ appointments — A grade: every client on pace

Onboarding SOPs completed on time (team) — A grade: all

Onboarding accuracy, revisions required (team) — A grade: 0–2/month

IT issues resolved on time (team) — A grade: 95%+

Ad tracker and R&D compliance (team) — A grade: all buyers hit both

Ad account passes completed — A grade: all 8 in the month

Grading accuracy vs the founder's spot-check — A grade: no disagreements

Cadence delivered on time (1:1s, ad account calls, red flags, scorecards) — A grade: all on time

SOP revisions cleared in the month due — A grade: all

Ramp-ups passed on schedule — A grade: all at 90%+, on time

Documented mistakes (all types) — A grade: 0–2/month

Requirements

Fluent English (written and spoken)

5+ years running Meta ads, with $500,000+ in proven ad spend managed

Local lead generation experience — home improvement strongly preferred

Agency experience managing a multi-client portfolio

Experience checking, training or managing other media buyers' work

Hands-on GoHighLevel — funnels, forms, automations

Comfortable with 
 (or similar), Google Sheets and dashboards

Available 9:00–17:30 UK time, Monday to Friday

Full-time and exclusive — no other clients, agencies or side projects





Bonus Skills

A formal team lead or management role over media buyers

Experience running a grading or bonus scheme

Power BI

Writing SOPs or training material



Who This Is For

Someone who's the best media buyer in the room and wants to make everyone else in it better. Someone who'd rather find the red account on Monday morning than hear about it from a client on Friday. Someone who can tell a colleague their work isn't good enough — and check the next week that it changed. Someone who wants to own the numbers, not just their own accounts.



Who This Is NOT For

Anyone who manages from a dashboard instead of opening the accounts. Anyone who quietly fixes other people's mistakes instead of telling them. Anyone who avoids hard conversations. Freelancers juggling other clients. Anyone who needs to be told what "good" looks like instead of building the standard themselves.

How to Apply

To be considered, you must apply here: 👉 
 



As part of your application, submit a Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering:



Who you are, the ad spend you've managed and the results you've got

A time you raised someone else's performance — trained them, checked their work or managed them — and what changed

Why you're the right person for this role



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Video Editor for Real Estate (Singapore) - Shorts/Reels
description:
We are looking for a dedicated, seasoned Video Editor with a proven track record of executing engaging, high-retention videos.



We are a stable, established boutique Singapore-based real estate team. You will be working directly with a top-performing real estate agent, helping her turn a large volume of raw footage into polished, daily content.



Students need not apply. We are looking for a mature, career-oriented professional who wants to build a long-term career with a growing company, not someone looking for a temporary gig.



The Role:

As a Full-Time Video Editor, you will be responsible for producing high-quality video content that aligns with our brand's vision.



She has a large backlog of raw footage. To start, your primary KPI will be to edit, deliver, and post one captivating short video per day (10-60 seconds) directly to her social platforms. In addition to the daily shorts, you will also be required to edit occasional long-form videos (e.g., property tours or deep dives) as needed.



Please note: The goal is ultimately a higher output. We are starting you at one short video a day so you can get used to the workflow, but you should expect the daily target to scale up to two short videos per day (plus the occasional long-form video) in the coming months. We need someone who is ready to handle that volume once fully onboarded.



We aren't looking for over-the-top Hollywood effects—we need clean, engaging edits with good pacing, dynamic captions, and smooth punch-ins/zooms to keep the viewer hooked.



Responsibilities:

• Take raw talking-head and property footage and edit it into 1 (eventually 2) high-quality short videos per day, plus occasional long-form videos. 

• Act as her social media publisher: you will be fully responsible for uploading, writing captions, scheduling, and posting the finalized videos on her behalf across her platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube). 

• Enhance videos with engaging text/captions, zoom ins/outs, sound effects, and clean transitions to maximize retention. 

• Review and select the best shots from raw footage, removing dead air and mistakes. 

• Incorporate feedback and revisions quickly and efficiently. 

• Stay up to date with video trends, audio, and best practices across all platforms.



Requirements:

• Proven work experience as a Video Editor (experience with both short-form vertical content and standard long-form horizontal content is highly preferred). 

• Minimum 3+ years of professional experience (we are looking for a reliable, seasoned professional). 

• Proficiency in video editing software (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, CapCut Pro, or similar tools). 

• Strong understanding of pacing, hook creation, and visual aesthetics for social media. 

• Ability to work independently, manage a daily content pipeline, and deliver projects strictly on deadline. 

• A stable internet connection and the necessary hardware to process video efficiently. 

• Attention to detail test: Please include the exact phrase "Reels Superhero" in the first line of your application so we know you took the time to read through these requirements.



Location:

This is a remote position based in the Philippines.



Application Process:

Send EXACTLY 5 links (not more, not less) to your best video edits. Please include at least one short-form video and, if possible, one long-form video (optional). 

Please do not include irrelevant videos like wedding highlights or personal vlogs. We only want to see your ability to edit engaging, high-retention content.

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a further assessment and interview.



We look forward to reviewing your creative work!

title: Remote Inbound/Outbound Sales Representative
description:
PLEASE APPLY HERE: https://apply.workable.com/town-web/j/A93DB3B8A0



Are you a proactive, confident, and competitive self-starter who takes extreme ownership over your work?



Do you hate to lose more than you like to win? 



Are you a natural problem solver who knows how to uncover client pain points and deliver practical, strategic solutions?



If so, as an Inbound/Outbound Sales Representative for Town Web, you will work closely with the Head of Sales to drive new business through both inbound inquiries and outbound reach. 



At Town Web, we use a consultative sales approach to help local governments modernize their digital presence. 



This role requires someone who is results-oriented, resourceful, and focused on building relationships and delivering long-term value — not just quick wins. 



Responsibilities: 

- Handle inbound sales inquiries and qualify interested prospects.

- Identify and engage high-potential target accounts through outbound outreach.

- Conduct discovery calls to understand client pain points and recommend relevant solutions.

- Conduct virtual demos that educate prospective customers, focusing on their specific needs and challenges. 

- Maintain an active and organized pipeline of leads and opportunities.

- When required, make 80–100 outbound calls daily (primarily warm/cold leads), with a goal of 3–5 qualified demo appointments booked per day. 

- Log all activity in the CRM and collaborate with the Head of Sales on next steps.

- Follow up with prospects via email and phone in a timely and professional manner, with a focus on closed deals. 



Who We’re Looking For: 

- Competitive, self-directed, and proactive.

- Comfortable in a respectfully-candid communication environment and willing to accept constructive feedback. 

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with high output expectations. 

- Confident making cold calls and navigating objections.

- A strategic communicator who can clearly connect client challenges with Town Web’s solutions.



Skills and Qualifications: 

- Minimum of three years' experience in outbound sales, from appointment setting through close. 

- Strong English communication skills (verbal and written). 

- Able to clearly explain value propositions. 

- Experience working remotely with US-based clients, ideally in B2B sales or SaaS.

- Familiar with CRMs, call tracking tools, and email outreach platforms.



Compensation: 

Hourly Rate: $10–$15 USD/hour based on experience.

Bonus Potential: Up to $1,000 or more a month based on deals closed. 



PLEASE APPLY HERE: https://apply.workable.com/town-web/j/A93DB3B8A0

title: Sales Manager
description:
PLEASE APPLY HERE: https://highgrowth-io.breezy.hr/p/517f2973720901-sales-manager



HighGrowth.io builds outbound sales teams for founder-led, bootstrapped, B2B companies ($500K to $5M ARR) in the US and Europe. We need an additional Sales Team Implementation Manager to help us scale.

 

In this role, you’ll lead and manage client sales team implementations end-to-end, while partnering closely with our founder on strategy, priorities, and continuous improvement of our outbound playbook. 



This is a high-ownership seat: part client delivery, part sales operations oversight, and a key right hand to a strategic executive.



The ideal candidate must be a strong sales leader, but also must be able to work with and alongside other strong personalities. Why? 



Your sales leadership experience will allow you to slot directly into this role, since you already know the general management principles of dialing and sales teams. However, you'll be following the HighGrowth.io playbook and working with the HighGrowth.io founder to adjust that playbook to the realities of the specific client.



Additionally, you'll be interacting with the founder (or founders) on the client side. If it's not already clear, bootstrapped founders tend to have very strong personalities.



What You’ll Be Doing:

 • Lead outbound sales implementations for a HighGrowth.io client.

 • Translate our outbound sales playbook into practical hiring, onboarding, metrics, and performance systems for the client.

 • Directly manage offshore dialers and salespeople, maintaining accountability through scorecards and simple performance rhythms.

 • Run performance reviews with the client team, assess progress, and work with the HighGrowth.io founder to adjust strategy as needed.

 • Work closely with our founder on non-client-facing founder priorities: process upgrades, internal projects, and playbook refinements.

 • Keep implementation projects organized, including timelines, deliverables, handoffs, and documentation.

 • Coordinate meetings, reporting, and other lightweight activities that keep delivery running smoothly.



We’re Looking For Someone Who Has:

 • Four-plus years of outbound B2B sales management experience, as a leader or coach.

 • Strong operational discipline: you like metrics, routines, and making performance visible.

 • Confidence running multiple workstreams without dropping details.

 • A founder-friendly mindset: proactive, structured, reliable, and comfortable with fast shifts.

 

This is a full-time, remote role. Your work hours will need to overlap with 9am to 4pm US Eastern Time. 

We rely heavily on Apple devices, applications, and services. You should have a post-2021 Mac for this job.

title: General Virtual Assistant Required for Marketing Agency (With Room to Grow)
description:
Company: Elevated Ambition Digital



Category: Virtual Assistance, Administrative Support



Skills Required: Client Onboarding, Data Entry, CRM Management, Process Documentation, Virtual Assistant

Difficulty: Medium

Length: More than 6 months

Level of Experience: Intermediate

Hourly Rate: $3-$10



About Us:

Elevated Ambition Digital is a digital marketing agency specializing in helping chiropractic and integrative clinics grow their business through high-converting digital advertising. We generate leads through social media campaigns and provide tailored marketing solutions to help our clients attract and retain more patients.



Why Work With Us?

We believe in supporting our team and providing an environment where dedicated, hard-working professionals can grow in their careers. When you join Elevated Ambition Digital, you can expect:



-Long-Term Stability – We’re looking for committed tea ---------- mbers who want a reliable and ongoing role.

-Growth Opportunities – As we expand, so will your role. There’s plenty of room for career advancement.

-Supportive Work Environment – We provide clear processes, training, and direct communication to help you succeed.

-Consistent Pay & Bonuses – Get paid on time with opportunities for performance-based bonuses.

-Work-Life Balance – Flexible work hours as long as tasks are completed on schedule.



Job Description:

We are looking for a rockstar Virtual Assistant to join our growing team. Your role will be crucial in managing client onboarding, handling CRM tasks, tracking campaign performance, and keeping our internal processes organized. If you are detail-oriented, hardworking, and proactive, this is a long-term opportunity with plenty of room for advancement!



Responsibilities:

-Send welcome and onboarding
s, agreements, and setup instructions to new clients.

-Set up Go High Level sub-accounts (offer setup, messaging, calendar, A2P, integrations).

-Ensure onboarding forms are completed and calls are scheduled promptly.

-Maintain and update Client and Master SOPs with process changes.

-Track and log client results in reporting tools (sync with
 stats when applicable).

-Set up ad campaigns after access is granted, ensuring compliance with platform guidelines.

-Send weekly performance reports to clients and daily updates to the team.

-Handle client check-in texts and respond to inquiries or complaints professionally.

-Keep all CRM and task management tools updated with accurate client data.



Skills Required:

-Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken).

title: Remote, full-time, long-term · Content & social media · PrestaShop · B2B outbound · Paid media
description:
About Adintime



Adintime is an online advertising marketplace. In Hong Kong (adintime.hk) we help advertisers and agencies plan and book advertising campaigns across out-of-home, press, radio and digital media. Advertisers find placements, prices and specs on our site and request quotes; our sales team turns those requests into signed campaigns.



We are hiring a hands-on marketer to make Adintime more visible in Hong Kong, bring us more qualified demand, and run campaigns for our clients when they ask for it.



What you will own, in order of priority



1. Content creation & social media

Run our social media accounts in Hong Kong (LinkedIn, Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube): editorial calendar, daily posting, community management and replies.

Create the content yourself: posts, carousels, short videos, visuals and campaign showcases built from our media placements and client campaigns. Tools: Canva, CapCut or equivalent.

Write in English; our Hong Kong colleague writes and validates the Traditional Chinese versions. You co-produce with her, you do not wait for her.

Track reach, engagement and the leads that come from social, and adjust the calendar every month on what worked.



2. Website conversion (PrestaShop)

Create and improve commercial pages directly in PrestaShop: product and category pages, rate information, FAQ, structured data, calls-to-action, internal linking.

Titles and meta descriptions written to win the click; conversion paths tested and measured.

Technical hygiene with our developers: Search Console, indexation, hreflang, page speed. Google Business Profile management.



3. Outbound

Work our visitor-identification tool (Lead Forensics) daily: identify companies visiting the site, find the right contact and reach out to them yourself 
, LinkedIn, WhatsApp) the same day. You qualify the need and the budget in conversation; once a prospect is warm, you hand it to our sales team with full context.

Run B2B outbound sequences 
, LinkedIn, WhatsApp Business) to advertisers and agencies, and re-engagement campaigns to past clients.

Keep the CRM clean: every lead has a source, a status and an owner.



4. Paid campaigns — for Adintime and, occasionally, for our clients

Plan, launch and optimise our own acquisition campaigns in Hong Kong on Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube), Meta 
, Instagram), TikTok Ads and LinkedIn Ads, in Traditional Chinese and English. Our own budget is small: the skill is in making every dollar count, not in spending.

Weekly optimisation: audiences, search terms and negatives, bids, creative and copy tests, landing-page match, conversion tracking in GA4 / Google Tag Manager. You report cost per lead every week.

Occasionally, a client asks us to run campaigns with their budget on any of these platforms: proposal, setup, creative brief, monthly reporting. You make that service deliverable and professional.



5. Reporting

One weekly scorecard: social reach and engagement, leads, cost per lead by channel, contacts reached, conversations opened, warm prospects handed to sales.

Clean GA4, Search Console and ad-platform dashboards. A 30-minute weekly call with the Managing Director; async on Slack the rest of the time.



What you will not do :

Close deals. You open conversations and warm prospects up; our sales team closes.

Work alone on Chinese copy. A native Cantonese colleague is your partner on anything in Traditional Chinese.



No AI-written content. AI tools are fine for research and analysis, but every word we publish — posts, ads, pages, titles, meta descriptions, outreach messages — is written by you. AI-generated copy hurts our search rankings and our reputation; publishing it is grounds for ending the contract.



Must-have

3+ years creating content and running social media accounts for a company or clients (LinkedIn, Instagram,
, TikTok), with results you can show: growth, engagement, leads.



Hands-on video and visual production: Canva, CapCut or equivalent. 

You can turn a photo of a billboard into a post people stop on.



PrestaShop: you have built and edited pages, products and categories in PrestaShop and are comfortable in its back office.

Solid hands-on experience in at least one of these two areas, and the will to learn the other:

Paid campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads or TikTok Ads, including conversion tracking in GA4 / GTM;

B2B outbound: LinkedIn prospecting,
 sequences (Lemlist, Instantly, Apollo or similar), CRM discipline.

Google Search Console, GA4 and spreadsheets at a working level.

Excellent written English — you write all copy yourself before it is localised.

Self-managed and numbers-driven: you can say what worked and what did not, every week.



Strong plus

Reading and writing Chinese (Traditional characters). Hong Kong searches and scrolls in Traditional Chinese; if you can read our pages, ads and competitors, you will move much faster. Spoken Mandarin or Hokkien is welcome but not required.

Paid campaigns across several platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn Ads), experience running ad accounts for clients with monthly reporting, and current Google Ads / Meta certifications.

Solid technical fundamentals in SEO, SEA and GEO — how search engines crawl, index and rank pages; how search ads and Quality Score work; and how AI assistants and Google AI Overviews choose the sources they cite (generative engine optimisation).

Experience with Lead Forensics or a similar visitor-identification tool (Leadfeeder, Dealfront, Apollo).

Experience in advertising, media or marketplaces.

Basic HTML / 
 markup.



How to apply

A 1–2 minute video (unlisted YouTube or Loom link) telling us why you are the right person for this role. No slides, no script read out loud — just you.

Two or three social media accounts or content pieces you produced, with the numbers behind them.

One paid account you managed (any platform), with the before/after numbers you are proud of.

One outbound sequence you wrote and its reply rate.

Your availability.

Start your subject line with the word BILLBOARD so we know you read the whole post.

title: Proofreader/Fact-Checker
description:
Position: Proofreader / Fact-Checker 

About us

Arch of the High Sierras is a fifteen-year-old family business located in Reno, Nevada. We specialize in making a wide variety of quality wall calendars. While our calendars serve a practical purpose, we hope that they also bring some beauty, inspiration, and laughter into people’s lives. 



We’re currently building our 2028 line and expect to produce about 1,000 unique calendar titles across a wide range of subjects, including nature, travel, pets, and inspiration.



We're seeking a detail-oriented full-time Proofreader/Fact-Checker to verify image information and polish calendars before sending files to our printer. This is a remote position, 40 hours per week, with a salary commensurate with experience. 



Responsibilities

Fact-checking 

- Verify the accuracy of photographer-supplied location information and animal species (both common and scientific names) for stock images from companies such as Alamy and DepositPhotos.

- Use online reference tools and search engines (including AI tools) to confirm:

City, region, and country for travel and nature images.

Correct common and scientific names for wildlife images.

Ensure species names follow CMOS style (for example, capitalization, italics, and ordering of common vs. scientific name).

- Flag any images where the location or species seems incorrect or uncertain, and add notes or reference links for our team to review.

-Follow our captioning style and update captions as needed for clarity and consistency.



Proofreading

-Proofread calendar pages (covers, monthly grids, back covers) for:

- Spelling, grammar, and punctuation.

- Consistency of style, terminology, and capitalization across related calendars.

- A quick visual review to ensure dates and holidays appear correct (we work from vetted templates, so you only need to flag anything that looks obviously wrong or out of place).

- Color accuracy and coordination, including checking that each month’s color palette matches and complements that month’s image.

- Record all edits clearly for our graphic designers using comments in Google Sheets.

- Collaborate with the in-house editing team and graphic designers to follow existing voice and style guidelines.



Requirements

- Proven experience as a proofreader, copy editor, or fact-checker, ideally in publishing, marketing, or educational content.

- Excellent command of written English, strong editorial judgment, and fluent English communication skills for working with a global team.

- High accuracy and attention to detail, including the ability to review your own work to correct typos and confirm that requested edits have been made.

- Strong online research skills and familiarity with reliable sources for geography and animals.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects at once, and meet daily deadlines.

- Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain consistency across many related projects.

- Critical thinker who can choose the best approach or solution for each project.

- Team player who communicates proactively and collaborates well with remote colleagues.

- Comfortable working in tools such as Slack, Toggl, Google Sheets & Docs, and PDFs.

- Willingness to use AI-assisted research tools for initial lookups (training and process guidelines provided).



Nice to have

- Background or strong interest in geography, travel, animals, or nature photography.

- Experience working with stock image companies (for example, Alamy, Depositphotos).

- Prior experience with calendar or book production.



Compensation and schedule

- Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- A 4-hour overlap with U.S. business hours is required; the standard start time is 5:00 a.m. Philippine time, with some flexibility by agreement.

- Salary commensurate with experience.

- Remote role; strong, reliable internet and contingency plans for both connectivity and electricity are required.



How to apply

Please include:

- A brief introduction explaining your proofreading and/or fact-checking experience.

- Examples of relevant work (or a short portfolio).

- Your CV.

- Your current location and typical working hours.



Selection process

- After reviewing your CV and portfolio, if we’d like to proceed with the interview process, we’ll send you a few trial tasks. This practical step is designed to give you an idea of the scope of work and help us evaluate your approach to determine if it fits our team’s needs.

- If selected to continue, you’ll have a video interview with two staff members.

title: Virtual Assistant — Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography
description:
Working with Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography means becoming an important part of a luxury wedding photography and cinematography team. The role is highly organized, client-focused, and requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to keep multiple weddings and deadlines moving forward.



💍 Client Communication & Lead Management



- Respond to potential wedding clients through Zola and other inquiry platforms.

- Respond to inquiries promptly, professionally, and warmly.

- Answer basic questions about our photography and cinematography services, packages, availability, and next steps.

- Follow up with potential clients who have not responded.

- Help move qualified leads through the booking process.

- Keep client information and communication organized and up to date.



📋 Managing Booked Wedding Clients



- Maintain communication with couples throughout the planning process.

- Send and track wedding questionnaires and make sure they are completed on time.

- Follow up with clients when important information or forms are outstanding.

- Schedule final consultations with couples before their wedding.

- Obtain and organize the couple's finalized wedding timeline.

- Review timelines for missing or important information and communicate anything that needs clarification to the photography/cinematography team.

- Keep track of important wedding dates, deadlines, and client tasks.

- Send reminders as needed so clients stay on schedule.



📅 Wedding Workflow & Organization



- Maintain an organized system for upcoming weddings and their associated tasks.

- Track which clients have completed questionnaires, consultations, payments, timelines, and other required items.

- Keep track of assigned photographers and videographers for each wedding, including their availability, assignments, and any changes to coverage or staffing.

- Scout and vet photographers and cinematographers who may be a good fit to join the Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography team.

- Research potential photographers and cinematographers through portfolios, websites, social media, and other professional platforms.

- Help coordinate initial outreach, collect portfolios/resumes, and organize candidate information for review.

- Help ensure nothing falls through the cracks as a wedding approaches.

- Coordinate information between clients and the photography/cinematography team.

- Flag important issues or time-sensitive items to management.



🎬 Post-Wedding Client Management



- Communicate with our photo and video editors regarding the status of wedding galleries and films.

- Track editing progress and expected completion dates.

- Follow up with editors when deadlines are approaching or additional information is needed.

- Keep clients informed regarding the expected timeframe for their deliverables.

- Respond to client questions regarding gallery, film, highlight video, album, and other deliverable timelines.

- Proactively communicate updates to clients rather than waiting for them to ask.

- Monitor completed deliverables and ensure they are sent to clients in a timely manner.

- Follow up on outstanding post-wedding items until the client's project is fully completed.



📧 Client Experience



- Provide a friendly, professional, and reassuring experience from the initial inquiry through final delivery.

- Maintain the warm, personal communication style that Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography is known for.

- Help clients feel that their wedding is being actively managed and that they have someone available to assist them.

- Handle routine questions independently while knowing when to escalate something to Garrett or management.



⭐ What We're Looking For



- Excellent written and verbal communication.

- Strong organization and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple weddings and deadlines simultaneously.

- Comfortable communicating with clients and vendors professionally.

- Reliable and responsive, especially when dealing with time-sensitive client requests.

- Comfortable using
, calendars, spreadsheets, CRM/client-management systems, and online wedding platforms.

- Ability to follow established workflows while also recognizing when something needs attention.

- Someone who takes ownership of tasks rather than simply waiting to be told what to do.



Overall Role



The goal of this position is to help make sure every client is taken care of from the first inquiry through final delivery. The VA will serve as an important organizational and communication link between potential clients, booked couples, photographers, cinematographers, editors, and the Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography team.



The ideal person will be proactive, organized, personable, and comfortable keeping track of many moving pieces while ensuring that clients consistently receive timely communication and a high level of service.

**Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM**

**Salary Increase After 3 Months Based on Performance**

We are a fast-growing pure dropshipping company specializing in **men's products and fashion**.



We create and test new video creatives every week through *
 & Instagram Ads**.



We are looking for someone who can take a product and turn it into **high-quality, sales-focused AI video ads**.

You need to understand:



**Product → Audience → Hook → Creative → Sale**



---

You will handle the creative process from start to finish:



**Product Brief → Creative Concept → AI Assets → Editing → Finished Ad**

* Create **20+ usable video creatives per day**

* Generate AI images and videos

* Edit the final videos

* Create UGC-style ads

* Create product demos

* Create talking-head and lifestyle/product videos

* Add captions, B-roll, music and sound effects

* Make multiple variations of the same product



The goal is not to make one beautiful video.



The goal is to create **many creatives that can stop the scroll and sell the product.**



---



# REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* **2–4+ years** of professional video editing or advertising creative experience

* Real experience creating *
/Instagram video ads**

* Strong video editing skills

* Strong knowledge of **CapCut**

* Premiere Pro is a plus

* Strong understanding of **hooks and sales psychology**

* Understanding of pacing, storytelling, B-roll, captions and sound design

* Experience with **AI image & video generation**

* Experience creating UGC-style ads

* Experience creating product demos

* Experience creating talking-head and lifestyle/product visuals

* Strong AI prompting skills

* Ability to maintain **product and character consistency**

* Ability to troubleshoot AI generation problems

* Ability to create multiple creative angles quickly

* Strong English communication

* Organized, fast and detail-oriented

* Able to work independently

* Performance-focused and creative



---



# AI TOOLS



You should have experience with tools such as:



**CapCut • Google Flow/Veo • Kling • Seedance • Runway • ElevenLabs**



Or similar AI tools.



You should also be someone who **actively learns new AI tools** and looks for faster ways to create better ads.



---



# IMPORTANT



We primarily create **men's clothing ads for
**.



You need to understand the difference between:



**Making a video**



and



**Making a video that sells.**

title: GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM & Automation Specialist
description:
Part-Time | Remote | 5–10 Hours Per Week Initially | Ongoing



We are an established Australian property services business looking for an experienced GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM & Automation Specialist to take ownership of the ongoing management, improvement and optimisation of our GHL system.



We already have GoHighLevel in place and use it for lead management, SMS and
 nurture, appointment bookings, marketing campaigns and CRM management.



We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to build a workflow when given step-by-step instructions.



We want someone who really knows GHL, can understand what we're trying to achieve, recommend the best way to build it and then implement it.



What You'll Be Doing



You'll take responsibility for managing and improving our GHL setup, including:



CRM pipelines and opportunity stages



Workflows and automations



SMS and
 nurture sequences



Lead segmentation, tags and custom fields



Meta/Facebook lead integrations



Google Ads lead tracking



Website and landing page enquiries



Forms and surveys



Calendars and appointment booking



Appointment confirmations and reminders



No-show and follow-up workflows



Cold lead re-engagement



Database reactivation campaigns



Internal notifications and task creation



Landing pages and funnels



Twilio/phone configuration



Domains, DNS and CNAME configuration



Webhooks and third-party integrations



Troubleshooting broken or conflicting workflows



Testing automations before they go live



Keeping the CRM clean and organised



Lead Nurture & Automation



This is an important part of the role.



Our leads are at different stages of their property journey. Some are ready now, some may be 3–6 months away and others are still researching.



We need someone who can help us create intelligent nurture journeys rather than simply sending everyone the same automated messages.



This will include:



New lead follow-up



Short-term nurture



Long-term nurture



Behaviour-based follow-up



Cold lead re-engagement



Database reactivation



Consultation follow-up



Proposal follow-up



Client onboarding and milestone workflows



Review and referral campaigns



Our communication should still feel personal and human, even when automation is happening behind the scenes.



Tracking & Reporting



We also want better visibility over where our business is actually coming from.



You should be able to help us improve tracking across:



Marketing Source → Lead → Appointment → Client → Revenue



This includes lead source attribution, campaign tracking, conversion rates, pipeline reporting and identifying where leads are dropping out of the process.



Your First Project



Your first priority will be to audit our existing GHL account before making major changes.



We want you to review:



Existing workflows and automations



Pipelines and opportunity stages



Lead capture



Meta and Google integrations



SMS and
 nurture



Calendars and appointment workflows



Tracking and attribution



Tags, custom fields and segmentation



Existing integrations



Any duplicated, broken or conflicting automations



From there, we'd like you to recommend what should be fixed, simplified, removed or improved, and then help us implement those changes.



Who We're Looking For



You must have strong hands-on GoHighLevel experience.



Ideally, you'll also have experience with:



Meta/Facebook lead integrations



Google Ads tracking



Twilio



 and SMS automation



Zapier and/or Make



Webhooks



Landing pages and funnels



DNS/CNAME configuration



Conversion tracking and attribution



CRM and sales pipeline design



Experience working with real estate, property, mortgage brokers or other high-value professional service businesses would be highly regarded.



Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is proactive.



We don't want to have to work out every technical solution ourselves and then tell you exactly what to build.



We want someone who can say:



"I understand what you're trying to achieve. Here's how I'd recommend we build it in GHL."



Hours



Initially approximately 5–10 hours per week, with the opportunity for ongoing work.



We're looking for someone who can become our go-to GHL person as the business continues to grow.



To Apply



Please include:



How long you've worked with GoHighLevel



Examples of GHL accounts/systems you've built or managed



Your experience creating nurture campaigns and sales automations



Your experience with Meta and Google tracking/attribution



Your experience with Twilio and integrations



Your hourly rate



Your current availability



And briefly answer:



If you inherited an existing GHL account with multiple workflows, pipelines and integrations, how would you approach auditing it before making changes?



Finally, to make sure you've actually read the job description, please include the words “I love property” somewhere in your application.



We're looking for genuine GHL expertise, so generic applications won't be considered.
