title: Stock Controller- 3PL Warehouses
description:
# Stock Controller – 3PL Warehouses (m/f/d)



**Remote – Philippines | Full-time | Permanent**



## #BEcomeMAXX



You are highly precise, comfortable working with numbers, and not satisfied until every stock difference has been explained?



As **Stock Controller – 3PL Warehouses**, you take ownership of the reconciliation between our external warehouses and SAP Business One. Your goal is simple: **every warehouse movement is correctly reflected in our ERP, every discrepancy is identified, and every open case is followed through until it is closed.**



Working remotely from the Philippines, you will collaborate closely with our Finance, Planning and Purchasing teams in Germany as well as our external 3PL warehouse partners.



You report directly to the **CFO in Germany** and play an important role in ensuring reliable inventory data across IronMaxx.



## Ready to perform? Your tasks with MAXXimum focus



### Daily Stock Control & SAP Booking



- Collect daily goods receipt and inventory reports from our external 3PL warehouses and compare them with planned deliveries in SAP.

- Proactively follow up on missing or delayed warehouse reports.

- Reconcile every purchase order line against the actual warehouse receipt, including **item, quantity, batch and best-before date**.

- Post Goods Receipt POs accurately in **SAP Business One**, including delivery note references and supporting documentation.

- Reconcile warehouse-to-warehouse transfers and ensure that quantities leaving one location are correctly received at the destination.

- Compare outbound shipments and customer returns reported by our warehouses with deliveries recorded in SAP.

- Ensure that inventory movements are documented completely and traceably.



### Difference & Clarification Management



- Identify stock, receipt and shipment discrepancies and transfer unresolved quantities into the designated clarification warehouse in SAP.

- Assign the correct reason code and maintain a structured log of every open case.

- Follow up with 3PL warehouses on discrepancies within **24 hours**.

- Follow up with suppliers within **48 hours** where supplier clarification is required.

- Request invoice corrections where received quantities differ from invoiced quantities.

- Track every discrepancy from identification through to final resolution.

- Provide a daily status update to Accounts Payable, Purchasing and the CFO.



### Weekly Inventory Reconciliation



- Perform a complete reconciliation of each 3PL warehouse against SAP by **item, quantity, batch and best-before date**.

- Investigate and explain all inventory differences.

- Review the clarification warehouse and document the **age, reason, owner and next action** for every open item.

- Identify partially delivered and overdue purchase orders and provide the Planning team with a clear recommendation to **close or keep open**.

- Maintain warehouse performance scorecards covering:

  - Report timeliness

  - Inventory differences

  - Open clarification cases

  - Resolution performance



### Month-End & Inventory Reporting



- Prepare the month-end stock reconciliation for each external warehouse.

- Support year-end stock confirmations and provide documentation required for financial audits.

- Support physical inventory counts and cycle counts performed by our warehouse partners.

- Identify unresolved stock cases older than **30 days** and prepare recommendations for claims, corrections or write-offs.

- Prepare the monthly inventory and reconciliation KPI pack for the CFO.

- Maintain and continuously improve the related SOPs and step-by-step procedures.



## Your impact – what success looks like



### Within your first 4 weeks



You independently manage the daily reconciliation process for all assigned external warehouses.



### Within your first 3 months



You achieve:



- **≥95%** of warehouse receipts posted by the next working day after arrival

- **≥90%** of inventory discrepancies resolved within 48 hours

- **≥99.5%** stock-line accuracy during weekly warehouse-to-SAP reconciliation

- Clear ownership and documented next steps for all remaining open clarification cases



## MAXXimum qualifications – what you bring



- At least **3 years of professional experience** in inventory control, stock reconciliation, warehouse administration, inventory accounting or Accounts Payable with three-way matching.

- Hands-on experience working with an ERP system. **SAP Business One is strongly preferred**, but experience with SAP, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics or comparable systems is also suitable.

- Very good written and spoken **English**.

- Confident professional communication with suppliers and logistics partners – clear, polite and persistent when follow-up is required.

- Advanced **Microsoft Excel** skills, including:

  - XLOOKUP

  - SUMIFS

  - Pivot Tables

  - Data cleaning and reconciliation

- Power Query experience is an advantage.

- Good understanding of warehouse and inventory processes such as:

  - Inbound receiving

  - Putaway

  - Warehouse transfers

  - Batch management

  - FEFO

  - Blocked stock

  - Returns

  - Cycle counts

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to trace a quantity through the complete process from **Purchase Order → Delivery Note → Warehouse Receipt → SAP Booking → Supplier Invoice**.

- A structured and disciplined working style with strong ownership of open cases.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating with international teams.



## Nice to have



- Practical SAP Business One experience, especially with:

  - Goods Receipt PO

  - Inventory Transfers

  - Batch Management

- Previous experience in **FMCG, food, sports nutrition or supplements**.

- Experience working directly with **third-party logistics providers (3PLs)**.

- Familiarity with European logistics and shipping documentation such as **delivery notes and CMRs**.



## Why IronMaxx?



- A long-term, full-time remote position with an international **sports nutrition and fitness brand**.

- Structured onboarding with clear SOPs and step-by-step procedures.

- SAP Business One training and a structured parallel run with the existing team.

- Direct collaboration with Finance and Supply Chain leadership in Germany.

- High ownership and direct visibility of the impact of your work.

- An international working environment with colleagues across Europe and the Philippines.

- A Philippines-based team that you become part of from day one.



**Ready to bring structure, accuracy and transparency to our international inventory operations?**



Then join IronMaxx and help us make sure that every unit, every batch and every warehouse movement is exactly where it should be.



**#BEcomeMAXX**

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer / Web Developer (AI-Assisted Coding)
description:
We're a small, fast-moving team building software for a national network of waterproofing and roofing contractors in the US. We run lean on purpose: a handful of people, heavy use of AI, and systems that do the work of a much larger company. We're looking for one strong builder to turn detailed specs into working products, using AI coding tools to move fast without cutting corners.



You'll work directly with the founder, who is based in Bali on the same timezone as the Philippines.



What you'll build



A custom app for HighLevel (GoHighLevel), the CRM our contractors use.

Built with OAuth, custom pages, custom workflow triggers and actions, custom objects and webhooks.

It connects contractors' CRM accounts to our own platform.

It adds a branded inspection report generator, an estimator and proposal builder, and job costing.

A HighLevel template that sets up contractor accounts: pipelines, custom fields, forms, calendars, workflows and message templates.

Our core web platform. A property and job record system with:

a mobile-first, offline-capable field app for technicians (photos, readings, checklists)

warranty registration and a review queue

dealer ordering and a certification portal

an internal admin dashboard

Lead-generation tools. An instant roof and basement estimator widget, data-driven property lists, and integrations with mapping and property-data APIs.



Detailed specs are already written. Your job is to build them well, ask good questions, and tell us when something in a spec won't work.



Our stack



TypeScript, React, Node.js

tRPC, Drizzle ORM, MySQL or Postgres

HighLevel API and Marketplace modules

REST APIs and webhooks

Cloudflare, Vercel or similar hosting

AI coding tools daily: Claude Code, Cursor or similar



You must have



3+ years building and shipping full-stack web apps in TypeScript and React, with live projects you can show us.

Daily, serious use of AI coding tools. You know how to direct them, review their output, catch their mistakes, and keep a codebase clean when AI writes most of the first draft.

Experience integrating third-party APIs: OAuth, webhooks, and working from documentation you've never seen before. HighLevel experience isn't required; we'll expect you to learn its developer platform quickly with the help of AI tools.

Solid backend fundamentals: auth and permissions, database design, API security, and never trusting client input.

Comfort with ownership. You test your own work, write clear updates, and finish things.

Good written English. Most of our communication is async and written.



Nice to have



HighLevel (GoHighLevel) experience: snapshots, workflows, the API, or a Marketplace app

Offline-first mobile web apps (PWA, background sync)

Maps and geospatial work (Mapbox or Google Maps, parcel or building-footprint data)

PDF report generation

Stripe or payment integrations

Experience with construction, field-service or contractor software



How we work



Full time, async-first, with a short daily check-in during PH business hours.

Paid tools: AI coding subscriptions and hosting accounts are covered.

Real responsibility from week one. You won't be maintaining someone else's ticket queue.

Everything you build is owned by the company, and you'll sign an NDA and IP assignment.



How to apply



Send a message with:



Links to 2–3 things you've built, and your role in each.

A time you had to learn an unfamiliar API or platform quickly. How long did it take to ship something working, and how did you use AI tools to get there?

A short description of how you use AI coding tools day to day, and one time an AI tool gave you wrong code and how you caught it.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Start your message with the word "PERMANENCE" so we know you read the whole post.

title: Full-Time B2B Systems Architect & Institutional Funding Manager
description:
Company: Green Taurus Investment Group

Salary: $800 / Month + 1% Uncapped Closed Deal Commission (Paid via EasyPay)

Position Type: Full-Time (40 Hours/Week, Remote via GHL / Residential VPS)



The Mission of this Position:



You will operate as a high-leverage Systems Architect and Revenue Operator for Green Taurus Investment Group. You must step into this role with the absolute clarity that the CEO’s personal and business credit profile is the foundation of the company's expansion, corporate structure, and brand profile.



We are seeking a heavily decorated Operations Supervisor or 7+ Year BPO Leader who can take a raw business plan and build out our entire Institutional Funding Arm inside our GoHighLevel (GHL) Pro infrastructure completely from scratch.

You must understand that our funding arm is a productized B2B asset class. You are not just filling out applications; you are building a repeatable, high-ticket corporate optimization product that we sell to outside business clients across multiple niches to unlock capital, while simultaneously using the exact same system internally to secure no-PG commercial fleet lines for our own vehicle and asset scaling.

Core Key Responsibilities (The Depths of the Funding Arm):



• The Funding Product Buildout: Productize our financial strategy into a repeatable, 3-phase client onboarding and fulfillment model inside GoHighLevel. You will own the creation of the systemized intake portals, compliance trackers, and document vaults from scratch.



• Lender Matrix Engineering: Map out, catalog, and maintain our proprietary Lender Matrix across Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 commercial institutions. You must know the exact underwriting data algorithms, revenue thresholds, and bureau-pull guidelines for major commercial auto and asset suppliers (e.g., Ally Business Finance, Ford Commercial Credit).



• Asset Compliance & Underwriting Audits: Run continuous, line-item audits on our parent company and client registries (EIN, D&B, Experian Business, Equifax Business). Clean up data discrepancies, eliminate high-risk NAICS code classifications, and align directories to pass automated bank underwriting pre-screens.



• Cash-Flow & Ratio Tracking: Analyze financial data, bank deposit velocity, and Debt Service Coverage Ratios (DSCR) to determine exact financing capacity and sequence loan/credit card applications to eliminate hard inquiry damage.



• B2B Client Acquisition & Market Research: Pivot into diverse business niches to conduct deep market research. You will deploy our automated GHL data-scraping pipelines and high-volume cold
 engines to target, attract, and close premium corporate accounts needing both customer traffic and capital structure optimization ($15,000/mo retainers).



Required Technical Proficiency & Experience:

• 3+ Years of BPO Leadership, Operations Supervision, or Commercial Underwriting Experience managing complex data streams, compliance registries, and investor portfolio tracking sheets.



• Advanced Mastery of GoHighLevel (GHL) Pro: Complete comfort building custom workflows, snapshot replication, and user-restricted permission pipelines from scratch.



• Advanced Tech Stack Automation: Direct, hands-on experience linking CRM software to external automation engines utilizing Make, Zapier, or n8n.



• Financial & Regulatory Nuance: Solid understanding of U.S. corporate credit compliance, asset insulation, the FCRA, and the mechanics of true No-PG (No Personal Guarantee) commercial funding lines.

To prove your absolute attention to detail and systems-first mindset, reply to this post with the phrase "FUNDING ARCHITECT" at the very top of your application line. title: Recruiter & People Operations Specialist, Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We're 20+ people today, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team. We need a lot more people in the coming period, and right now hiring runs on the side of people who have other jobs to do. That has to change.



This is a Long-Term Career Opportunity



We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location & Type



- Remote

- Full-time (40 hours/week), with working hours that overlap with Netherlands business hours

- Long-term contractor position



What You'll Do



You'll build our hiring system from the ground up. You'll recruit for both our remote team (developers, engineers, sales and marketing roles) and our Dutch team, and you'll own what happens after the contract is signed too: onboarding and performance reviews.



There is no existing process to take over. There's a handful of vacancy texts, an onboarding guide, and a lot of know-how in people's heads. Your job is to turn that into a system that works without anyone chasing it every day.



- Build the pipeline: sourcing, screening, interview flow, and offers, end-to-end

- Write and post vacancies: on LinkedIn, job boards, and local channels, for local and Dutch candidates

- Source actively: especially senior developers and engineers who aren't actively looking

- Screen candidates: review video applications and run first screening calls

- Coordinate interviews: plan interviews and technical assessments with our Head of Technology and team leads

- Set up the tooling: an applicant tracking system, kept clean and up to date

- Own onboarding: accounts, access, a first-week plan, and making sure a new hire is productive fast

- Run performance reviews: set up a review cycle together with leadership and keep it running

- Report on hiring: open roles, pipeline, time to hire, and where candidates drop off

- Support operations: help with our ISO 27001 work and keeping track of legislation that affects how we work



Recruitment, onboarding and reviews are the core. The rest of the scope will take shape as the role grows, so expect some variety.



What We're Looking For



Must-Have Skills:

- 3+ years recruitment experience, ideally in tech or IT

- Experience sourcing developers and technical profiles

- You can tell a strong engineer from a strong CV, and you know which questions to ask

- Experience setting up or improving a hiring, onboarding, or HR process

- Excellent English communication (written and verbal)

- Organized and reliable: you follow up without being asked



Nice-to-Have Skills:

- Experience recruiting for international or remote teams

- Experience with Dutch candidates or the Dutch job market

- ATS experience (Teamtailor, Recruitee, Workable, or similar)

- LinkedIn Recruiter

 -Experience running performance reviews

- Experience with ISO 27001, compliance documentation, or HR-related legislation

- Notion, Google Workspace, Slack



AI tools are welcome:

We're an AI company. If you use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to write vacancies, screen CVs, prepare interviews, or build your own recruiting workflows, tell us how. We'd rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What We Offer:

- Long-term partnership: we're investing in your future with us

- Build something from zero: you design how MSTR hires, onboards, and grows people

- Direct impact: every hire you make shapes the team for years

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



How to Apply



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please DO NOT apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a Short Video (3-7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:

1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into recruitment.

2. A hard-to-fill role: Tell us about a role you struggled to fill. Where did you look, how did you find the right person, and how did you know they were right?

3. A process you built: Describe a hiring, onboarding, or review process you set up or improved. What did it look like before, what did you change, and what was different afterwards?

title: Real Estate Media Production & Delivery Assistant — Part-Time VA
description:
Estate Productions is a real estate photography and video company based in North Carolina. I’m looking for an organized, reliable virtual assistant to help manage what happens after each shoot from organizing files to coordinating editors and preparing client deliveries.



I currently handle all photography and videography myself. We already outsource photo and video editing, so your role will be to keep production organized, on schedule, and ready for delivery.



Your responsibilities



Organize uploaded photos and video footage into clearly labeled property folders.



Submit photos to AutoHDR using our instructions, download finished images, and flag obvious editing issues.



Prepare video editing briefs using my notes, voice recordings, and reference links.



Send footage and instructions to our video editing company.



Track deadlines, follow up with editors, and communicate revision requests.



Check finished assets for missing files, incorrect spelling, and requested deliverables.



Upload completed content to our delivery platform and prepare client delivery messages.



Maintain a job tracker showing each project’s status, deadline, and next step.



You’ll start with file organization and production coordination. As you learn our workflow, you may also help with client delivery and routine client communication.



Who I’m looking for



Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills.



Clear written English.



Reliable internet capable of uploading and downloading large media files.



Comfort working with cloud storage, spreadsheets, and online software.



Ability to follow checklists, meet deadlines, and ask questions when something is unclear.



Someone interested in a consistent, long-term working relationship.



Experience supporting a photographer, video editor, or real estate media company is a plus. Experience with AutoHDR or Aryeo is helpful but not required—we’ll provide training on our workflow.



Schedule and compensation



This is a remote, part-time position. We’ll agree on a consistent schedule that aligns with our North Carolina production and delivery deadlines. Please include your available hours and time zone in your application.



Please provide your expected hourly rate in USD. Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical trial before we commit to an ongoing arrangement.



How to apply



Use “Estate Productions — Production Assistant” as your application subject line and include:



A short introduction and your relevant experience.



Your available working hours and time zone.



Your expected hourly rate in USD.



Your internet upload and download speeds.



Any experience managing photo/video files or coordinating editors.



Your answer to this question: If an editor misses a deadline and a client’s delivery is due soon, what would you do?



I’m looking for someone who can become a dependable part of the team and help me spend more time shooting and growing the business.

title: Senior SEO Developer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them.



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

 • Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

 • Crawlability and indexation

 • Site architecture and internal linking

 • Canonicalization and rendering issues

 • Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

 • Work directly within:

 • WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

 • Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

 • PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

 • Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

 • Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

 • Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

 • Use SEO tools to diagnose issues, but rely on implementation, not automation alone



Required Skills & Experience

 • 3+ years of hands-on technical SEO implementation

 • Comfortable editing live websites and templates

 • Working knowledge of:

 • HTML, CSS, JavaScript (rendering understanding required)

 • PHP and Shopify Liquid

 • Experience working directly inside:

 • WordPress, Shopify, and PHP-based e-commerce platforms

 • Strong understanding of:

 • Google Search Console

 • Ahrefs / Semrush

 • Screaming Frog, Lighthouse, GTmetrix

 • Able to clearly explain why SEO actions are taken and how they affect rankings

 • Good command of spoken and written English



Nice to Have

 • Experience with SQL or Python / Node.js for SEO automation

 • Practical exposure to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI search)

 • Proven examples of technical changes leading to ranking improvements



Important Notes

 • This is not a strategy-only or reporting-only role

 • Candidates who rely mainly on plugins, widgets, or third-party apps without understanding the underlying technical mechanics will not be suitable

 • You must be comfortable implementing changes yourself

✦ CREATIVE DESIGNER AND OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

Remote | Australian Event Design Studio

We’re looking for a Creative Designer and Operations Assistant with an exceptional eye for design, previous Interior Design experience, and strong organisational and communication skills.



This role combines creative design with the practical coordination behind our projects. You’ll create polished concepts and presentations while also helping manage proposals, client correspondence, project information and everyday administration.

You’ll work closely with our Creative Director and office team, supporting projects from the initial brief through to proposal preparation and planning.



Using our professionally designed Canva templates, creative direction and project information, you’ll customise presentations to reflect each client’s vision.



You’ll thoughtfully incorporate furniture, florals, décor, colour palettes and layouts, paying attention to scale, proportion and composition.



Alongside the design work, you’ll help keep proposals, client communication, project documents and deadlines organised. You must be comfortable switching between creative work and detailed administration.



We provide templates, systems and guidance, but we also want someone who contributes ideas, identifies missing information and takes initiative.



✦ CREATIVE DESIGN RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create wedding concepts, corporate event presentations and styling mock-ups.

• Assist with branding and social media graphics as the role develops.



✦ OPERATIONS AND ADMIN RESPONSIBILITIES



• Assist with preparing and updating proposals in Quotient using approved scope and pricing.

• Respond professionally to routine client enquiries and help gather outstanding information.

• Coordinate revisions and approvals with the Creative Director and office team.

• Assist with supplier enquiries, quotes and availability confirmations.

• Help prepare project summaries, item lists and information for the warehouse and installation team.

• Support our Office Manager and Director with day-to-day administration.



Accuracy matters as much as presentation. The right person will notice an incorrect quantity, missing detail or approaching deadline as readily as a design that needs refinement.



✦ HOW YOU’LL WORK WITH US



1. CLIENT DISCOVERY

Our Creative Director meets with the client to understand their vision, style and requirements.



2. BRIEF AND PROPOSAL

The team develops the creative direction, scope and pricing. You’ll help organise the information and prepare the proposal.



3. DESIGN AND MOCK-UPS

You’ll create concepts and presentations that help the client visualise their event.



4. REVIEW AND REFINEMENT

We’ll review the work together, refine the details and prepare it for presentation.



5. PROJECT COORDINATION

You’ll help keep approved information, correspondence and planning documents accurate and up to date.



✦ ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



• Previous Interior Design experience, with a strong understanding of space, layout, colour, styling, scale and visual composition.

• Strong Canva skills and a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful, polished design.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong organisation, attention to detail and time management.

• Confidence communicating professionally with clients and suppliers.

• Ability to work efficiently, manage revisions and meet deadlines.

• Initiative and sound judgment when working independently.

• Comfort with both creative work and routine administration.

• A reliable computer, internet connection and suitable workspace.



Experience in weddings, events or luxury brands is highly regarded.



Experience with Quotient, 
 and Google Workspace would be an advantage.



✦ WHAT WE OFFER



• Remote working with agreed availability overlapping Sydney business hours.

• A variety of creative projects across weddings, events and brand activations.

• Established templates, systems and support from our team.

• Opportunities to contribute ideas and improve how we work.

• Scope to develop your skills in design, proposals and project coordination.

• A long-term opportunity to grow with the business.

JB’s is a veteran-owned construction and home-services business based in Northwest Florida. We serve our neighbors through electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, remodeling, construction, and related services.

We are looking for an experienced ServiceTitan Administrator who can become our internal ServiceTitan Champion.

Our goal is straightforward: our team needs a knowledgeable person who can answer questions, solve problems, complete administrative work, maintain the system, and help us use ServiceTitan effectively—without every issue going back to the owner.

This is a hands-on execution role, not a consulting-only position. We need someone who can both explain what needs to happen and complete the work.

Your primary responsibility

Take ownership of day-to-day ServiceTitan administration and internal support.

When a team member has a question or something is not working properly, you will investigate, resolve what is within your authority, coordinate with ServiceTitan support when necessary, and follow the issue through to a verified resolution.

You are not expected to know every answer immediately. You are expected to know how to investigate, find reliable answers, communicate clearly, and follow through.

What you will own

Team support and troubleshooting

Be the first point of contact for ServiceTitan questions from our office, technicians, sales staff, and managers. Help team members understand the correct workflow and investigate problems involving customer records, jobs, estimates, invoices, memberships, mobile usage, and system settings.

Distinguish between a training issue, a configuration issue, missing information, and a problem that requires ServiceTitan support.

Daily administration and system maintenance

Complete approved updates to records, templates, forms, job types, business units, and other settings within your assigned scope. Maintain a visible request list so important work does not get forgotten.

Identify incomplete or inconsistent records, investigate the cause, and coordinate corrections with the responsible department. Do not guess at missing financial information or change records simply to make a report look correct.

Pricebook maintenance

Maintain our approved pricebook structure, descriptions, categories, images, and related information. Implement approved service, material, equipment, and pricing updates.

Work with management and accounting to identify missing information or setup problems. Pricing strategy, margin targets, and accounting-policy decisions remain with authorized leadership.

For bulk changes, document the starting point, validate the proposed changes, obtain required approval, and verify the results after implementation.

Reporting and data quality

Prepare and maintain useful reports for management, including approved views of department performance, sales, completed work, unsold estimates, memberships, and job-cost information where available.

Understand what a report measures, which dates and filters it uses, and what information may be incomplete. Investigate discrepancies instead of simply forwarding a spreadsheet to the owner.

Maintain recurring report delivery and help managers understand how to use their reports.

Training and documentation

Create short, practical instructions and screen-recorded walkthroughs for recurring tasks. Train new employees on the workflows relevant to their roles and help existing employees correct repeated mistakes.

Maintain a JB’s ServiceTitan knowledge library so the same questions do not need to be answered from scratch repeatedly.

Help translate our approved operating procedures and Nexstar-based service processes into practical system workflows.

ServiceTitan support and vendor follow-through

Own support cases from initial investigation through resolution. Provide clear examples, relevant screenshots, affected record identifiers, and steps already attempted.

Attend appropriate support or account meetings, document action items, and complete approved follow-up work. Escalate decisions requiring management approval with a clear explanation and recommended next step.

Connected tools and ongoing improvements

Help investigate problems involving our approved ServiceTitan-connected tools, including website booking and other integrations we use.

Coordinate with vendors or technical specialists where needed. Advanced programming is not a core requirement, but you should be able to explain a problem clearly and test whether a fix works.

Recommend practical improvements while working within our existing subscriptions and approved budget.

Required experience

You must have at least two years of meaningful, hands-on ServiceTitan experience, including administration, configuration, troubleshooting, reporting, or implementation work.

Experience limited to call answering, appointment booking, or dispatching is not sufficient by itself.

You should be able to demonstrate:

- ServiceTitan administrative work you personally completed, including pricebook maintenance and reporting.

- Successful troubleshooting and the ability to explain a workflow to a nontechnical team member.

- Strong spreadsheet skills, attention to detail, and careful handling of imports or bulk changes.

- Clear written and spoken English, dependable live availability, and independent follow-through.

Experience supporting U.S. HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other home-service businesses is strongly preferred.

Preferred qualifications

ServiceTitan Certified Administrator certification is preferred. Please identify your credential and current status.

Experience with multi-trade businesses, memberships, job costing, QuickBooks integration support, purchasing or inventory workflows, and Nexstar-based operations is helpful.

Please be honest about which areas you know well and which would require additional training.

Authority and working relationships

You will report to the owner and work closely with our call-center manager, service manager, sales professional, and accounting support.

You will own system support and execution, not override department leaders.

Dispatch priorities, customer commitments, pricing policy, financial approvals, and employee-management decisions remain with the appropriate manager or owner.

You must obtain approval before making high-impact changes, enabling paid services, changing financial mappings, expanding access, or making changes that affect multiple departments.

What success looks like

Our team knows where to go for ServiceTitan help. Routine issues get handled without the owner becoming involved. Approved changes are completed accurately. Reports are dependable and clearly explained. Recurring problems lead to better training or a corrected process.

Most importantly, you make ServiceTitan easier for our team to use while reducing the owner’s daily administrative workload.

How to apply

Apply with the subject:

JB’s ServiceTitan Champion — Your Name

Include your résumé, expected monthly compensation, availability, and answers to these questions:

1. How long have you worked in ServiceTitan, and what administrative responsibilities did you personally own?

2. Describe a difficult ServiceTitan problem you investigated and resolved. What did you check, change, and verify?

3. What pricebook and reporting work have you completed yourself?

4. Have you trained other employees or managed ServiceTitan support cases? Give an example.

5. Which ServiceTitan areas are your strongest, and which would require additional training?

Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical assessment and live walkthrough using provided sample information or an appropriately controlled environment.

Do not submit confidential information, customer records, or unauthorized screenshots from another employer.

title: Social Media Account Manager, Remote,  Performance Bonuses Available
description:
Read the WHOLE Job description! If information asked for is not submitted, I will not respond. 

About the role

We run a network of pet and beauty content pages, and we're scaling fast. We need one reliable person whose only job is to create new Instagram and
 accounts, warm them up properly, and then post our finished videos on them so each account has the best chance of growing. You won't make the videos. We give you the content, and you handle the accounts. YOU DO NEED MORE THAN ONE PHONE TO START IN THIS POSITION.



What you'll do



- Create new Instagram and
 accounts, with their profiles set up properly (name, bio, profile photo, links).

- Warm up each account every day for the set warm-up period. That means scrolling, watching, liking, following, and commenting like a normal user in the right niche, before it ever posts.

- Keep accounts organized in a spreadsheet to have a clean setup, so the accounts never get linked with the same info.

- Post our videos on the warmed-up accounts on the schedule we give you, with the captions and hashtags we provide.

- Keep a tracking sheet for every account: the date it was created, warm-up progress, when it started posting, views, followers, and any warnings or restrictions.

- Watch each account's health, and flag drops in views, restricted features, or shadow bans right away.

- Follow our posting rules exactly, so the same video isn't posted the same way on multiple accounts.



What we're looking for



- Two or more working smartphones that you already own. We plan to buy more for you if you do well.

- You understand how Meta flags accounts: device and IP linking, repeated content, spammy behavior, and fast follow or unfollow patterns.

- Strong organization and attention to detail, because you'll be tracking many accounts.

- You're consistent and reliable, and you can show up daily without being reminded.

- Comfortable using Google Sheets and following written instructions.

- Good written English, and you can send a daily report of what you did.



Pay



- $300 a month base, paid monthly.

- A bonus for every account that blows up, with the exact amount and what counts as "blowing up" set in advance (for example, a set dollar amount per account that passes a view or follower milestone).

- A phone upgrade or new devices after you've proven yourself.



How to apply

Send us the following:



- The number of accounts you've created and warmed up before, and how you did it.

- How many phones you have, and the models.

- Screenshots of any accounts you've grown, with views or followers.

- A short description of how you'd warm up a brand-new Instagram account in its first couple days.

- How many hours a day you can work.

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: AI Output Evaluator
description:
AI Output Evaluator



We are looking for a detail-oriented, highly disciplined Independent Contractor to evaluate AI-generated outputs (images, videos, audio, and text) for a U.S.-based AI training project.



The Work:

You will compare two AI-generated responses side-by-side and determine which one better satisfies a specific prompt based on observable evidence. You will be trained on our strict evaluation rubric and expected to write brief, evidence-based justifications for your choices.



Technical Requirements (Mandatory):

• All work MUST be performed on a provided AWS Virtual Machine (VM) accessed via Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP).

• You are strictly prohibited from using your personal computer, personal browser, or personal storage devices for task work.

• You must have a stable internet connection capable of maintaining a consistent RDP connection.

• You may not install any software on the AWS VM.



Compliance & Rules (Zero Tolerance):

• You must only work on tasks you are authorized to do (we will provide required attributes).

• You must log accurate active work hours. Time fraud (logging hours not actively worked) is grounds for immediate termination.

• Absolutely no use of ChatGPT, Claude, or any external AI tools to assist with evaluations.

• Strict confidentiality is required. You may not screenshot, copy, or share any task materials.

• Maximum 14 hours per day / 40 hours per week.



Schedule & Pay:

• Full-time: 40 hours per week (M–F 8 hours/day preferred, but flexible as long as 40 hours are reached).

• Pay is structured as a revenue share equivalent to $4.50 per hour of active work on the AI platform.

• First week: $100 paid once 24 active hours are reached, and the remaining $80 paid at week's end.

• Ongoing: Weekly payouts processed by Handshake AI on Wednesdays (covering Mon–Sun of the previous week), taking 24–48 hours to clear.

• No taxes are withheld. You are responsible for your own taxes.



To apply: Please confirm you understand that this is a 1099 Independent Contractor role, that you can strictly follow the AWS VM/RDP requirement, and that you are comfortable with the revenue-share pay structure.

You'll Be Designing

1. Meta Image Ads 
 & Instagram)

Scroll-stopping static and carousel ads built for paid social. This means designing for attention in the first frame, integrating hooks and copy directly into the visual, following platform specs (aspect ratios, text-to-image ratio, safe zones), and producing multiple variations of the same concept for A/B testing. This is direct-response design — every choice should serve conversion, not just aesthetics.



2. Product Listing Images (Shopify, Shopee, Amazon, TikTok Shop)

Main and gallery images for product listings across our e-commerce storefronts and marketplaces. Each platform has its own rules and conventions — Amazon's strict main-image requirements, Shopee/TikTok Shop's infographic-heavy slide format, Shopify's flexibility for lifestyle shots. You'll need to communicate features, specs, and value props clearly within a handful of image slots, and design within each platform's compliance guidelines.



3. Email Marketing Graphics

Banner images, promotional graphics, and visual assets for email campaigns (e.g. Klaviyo flows — welcome series, abandoned cart, promotions). These need to be lightweight, mobile-responsive, and designed to work seamlessly within email templates and alongside copy — not standalone art pieces.



4. Website Landing Pages (Replo/CF/Pagefly/Gempages experience preferred)

Designing and building landing pages for Shopify's Landing Pages, campaigns and product launches — hero sections, benefit blocks, testimonials, FAQs, and CTAs. Experience building directly in Replo (or a similar visual page builder like Shopify's native page editor) is a strong plus, since this role may involve assembling pages, not just handing off static designs.



5. Social Media Organic Images

Feed posts, carousels, and graphics for non-paid social content. This is a different register from ad design — more native, community-oriented, and trend-aware, less overtly "salesy." Consistency with brand aesthetic and quick turnaround matter more here than heavy testing.



You may be a fit if:

1. You have experience designing paid social ads & landing pages

2. You understand what makes an ad and Landing pages convert, not just look nice

3. You can think like a performance marketer, not just a designer

4. You move fast, take feedback well, and enjoy testing creative ideas

title: Senior Dispute Specialist | Credit Repair Company
description:
About us

We're a growing credit-building company that wins through accuracy, not gimmicks. Our disputes are factual, well-documented, and grounded in consumer law. We're hiring one standout dispute specialist to help raise the bar.



The role

You'll own the dispute process from report review to resolution. You'll find what's inaccurate, prove it, and force compliance.



What you'll do



 • Audit Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion reports for inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable items

 • Identify Metro 2 errors (account status, payment history, DOFD, balances, compliance condition codes)

 • Write sharp, legally grounded disputes citing the FCRA, FDCPA, and FCBA

 • Escalate non-compliant responses with strong follow-ups

Who we want



 • Deep knowledge of the FCRA, FDCPA, and Metro 2, not just surface-level templates

 • Expert at reading tradelines and spotting inconsistencies across bureaus

 • Excellent written English. Disputes are letter-heavy.

 • Meticulous, self-driven, and calm under deadlines

 • Reliable computer and stable internet connection

 • Professional and ethical, with respect for client confidentiality



Non-negotiables



 • We dispute only what's inaccurate, outdated, or unverifiable

 • No guarantees, no fake identities or "credit privacy numbers," and full compliance with CROA and state law

 • Signed NDA and confidentiality agreement required before accessing any client data



What you get



 • Remote, flexible schedule

 • Competitive USD pay with bonuses tied to results

title: Case Manager - Lemon Law
description:
Summary

**Remote | California Lemon Law Firm | Full-Time

 

** We are a California law firm focused on lemon law and consumer protection litigation, and we are looking for a licensed attorney to join our team as a Case Manager. 

 

This is a hands-on position for an attorney who can manage cases, communicate directly with clients, stay on top of deadlines, and move cases forward from intake through settlement. 

 

## What You’ll Do 

* Manage an assigned caseload from intake/retainer through settlement or resolution. 

* Communicate directly with clients, provide case updates, answer routine questions, and maintain strong client relationships. 

* Request, review, and organize documents and evidence from clients. 

* Review purchase documents, repair orders, warranty records, service history, manufacturer communications, and other case-related documents. 

* Analyze case facts and identify missing information, potential issues, and case strengths/weaknesses. 

* Draft legal documents, including pleadings, discovery, meet-and-confer correspondence, declarations, motions, settlement documents, and other case-related correspondence. 

* Prepare and file documents with the court and assist with e-filing as needed. 

* Track case deadlines, hearings, discovery obligations, settlement deadlines, and other important dates. 

* Coordinate with attorneys, paralegals, case managers, and other members of the team. 

* Maintain accurate and organized case files and case-management records. 

* Follow cases closely and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. 

* Escalate significant legal or case issues when attorney review or strategy decisions are needed. 

 

## What We’re Looking For **Required:** 

 

* An active attorney license in good standing. 

* Experience handling lemon law cases OR civil litigation. 

* Strong legal writing and analytical skills. 

* Excellent communication and client-management skills. 

* Ability to independently manage multiple cases and competing deadlines. 

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment. 

* Professional, responsive, and comfortable communicating directly with clients. 

 

## Preferred 

* Direct California lemon law experience. 

* Experience handling cases from intake through settlement. 

* Experience with pleadings, discovery, motions, settlement negotiations, and court filings. 

* Experience using case-management software such as Filevine. 

* Experience working in a remote law-firm environment. 

 

## The Ideal Candidate 

We are looking for someone who can own their cases rather than simply complete individual assignments. You should be comfortable communicating with clients, reviewing documents, drafting legal work, managing deadlines, coordinating with the team, and keeping a case moving without needing to be reminded about every next step. If you have lemon law experience, that's a strong advantage. If you have solid civil litigation experience and can learn the firm's lemon law process, we are also interested in speaking with you. 

 

## How to Apply 

 

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction explaining your relevant lemon law or civil litigation experience. 

 

### Important 

Read Before Applying To confirm that you have read the entire job posting, include the title and author of the latest book you've read in the subject line of your application. Applications that do not include the code word may not be considered.

title: Marketer
description:
GROWTH MARKETING MANAGER



Growth & Customer Acquisition Manager — HVAC & Electrical



We are looking for an independent Growth Marketing Manager who will take ownership of the company's entire marketing function: strategy, paid and organic channels, content, and analytics. The primary result of this role is new customers, collected revenue, and profit. Not posts, not impressions, not reports



Compensation is a percentage of the revenue generated by the marketing system you build. There is no income cap.



============================================================

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

============================================================



Someone who thinks like an entrepreneur and treats every company advertising dollar as their own. Someone who understands marketing, sales, and unit economics. You develop the plan, you execute it, you shut down what does not work and scale what does. You do not wait for instructions.



Technically, this is a strong generalist who uses AI to cover the workload that previously required several separate specialists: performance, SEO, content, video, and analytics.



============================================================

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

============================================================



Overall practical experience in digital / growth marketing: 5+ years, including at least 2 years independently developing and executing growth strategy.



By area:



- Performance marketing and customer acquisition with responsibility for budget and results: 3+ years

- Google Ads — independently managing campaigns and budgets: 3+ years

- SEO and Local SEO (preferably for local service businesses): 3+ years

- Google Business Profile / Google Maps: 3+ years

- Marketing analytics, tracking, attribution, ROAS / CAC / CPL: 3+ years

- Meta / Instagram Ads and short-form content: 2+ years

- Video marketing, YouTube, content production: 2+ years

- Yelp and other local lead-gen platforms: preferably 2+ years

- AI tools in marketing (research, copy, image/video generation, automation): 2+ years, or demonstrated advanced ability with fewer years



Years alone are not what matters. The candidate must show concrete results from previous projects: budget, leads, CAC, ROAS, sales, and collected revenue. See the Proof of Experience section below.



============================================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO

============================================================



1. STRATEGY AND GROWTH PLAN



Independently analyze the market and competitors, develop a customer acquisition plan, present it to management, and execute it. The plan covers every channel (SEO, Google Maps, Google Ads, Meta, Yelp, YouTube, content, referrals, partnerships, existing customer base marketing), new territories, locations, and services, as well as targets for CPL, CAC, conversion rate, average ticket, ROAS, and profitability.



2. MAXIMUM RESULTS WITH MINIMUM BUDGET



Increasing the advertising budget is not a strategy. Before asking for more ad spend, the manager must look for growth elsewhere: improve the offer, creatives, and landing pages; raise conversion rate and lead quality; reduce CPL and CAC; grow organic traffic, average ticket, repeat business, and referrals.



The long-term objective is marketing assets (Google Maps, SEO, content, reviews, customer base) that bring in customers without advertising costs growing proportionally.



3. PAID CHANNELS



Google Ads. Building and auditing campaigns; Search, Remarketing, Performance Max, and YouTube Ads when economically justified. Keyword management, negative keywords, search term analysis, ad copy, landing pages, conversion and call tracking, A/B testing of offers. Optimization for CPL, CAC, ROAS, and profit — not clicks.



Meta / Instagram. Strategy, original creatives, Reels, Stories, testing audiences, offers, and messaging, campaign management, organic reach growth. Every piece of content has a purpose: Attention → Trust → Lead → Customer → Revenue.



Yelp. Profiles for real locations, optimization, review responses, Yelp Ads only when the economics work. If the channel does not deliver customers at an acceptable cost, the manager recommends reducing or reallocating the budget.



4. ORGANIC CHANNELS



SEO. Strategy, technical audit, keyword and competitor research, service pages and legitimate city / service-area pages, site structure, SEO content, internal linking, backlinks, indexing and ranking monitoring. Success is measured not by the number of pages, but by calls, customers, and revenue from organic search.



Google Business Profile / Google Maps. Creating and verifying profiles only for real locations in compliance with Google requirements, full optimization, regular updates, photos and videos, a legitimate strategy for growing the quantity and quality of reviews, review responses, local ranking and competitor analysis. Each profile is a separate channel with its own tracking of calls, leads, and revenue.



YouTube. An educational channel and a long-term asset: concepts, scripts, Shorts, AI video, voice-over, editing, project and educational videos. Not treated as a source of quick ROI.



5. CONTENT



Content from every project. Every completed job is a marketing asset. We need a system that turns real projects into before / after content, Reels, Shorts, YouTube videos, case studies, and content for GBP, the website, SEO, and ad creatives. One project — multiple pieces of content for multiple platforms, using AI for speed and lower cost.



Educational content. The company should become a source of useful information for homeowners: why an air conditioner is not cooling, repair vs. replace, how to choose a heat pump, how equipment is sized, when an electrical panel upgrade is needed, why permits and inspections matter, how to compare contractor estimates, what not to save money on. The chain: Educate → Build Trust → Create Demand → Generate Leads → Generate Revenue. A person may not be looking for anything today — but when they need us, they will remember us.



Viral content. Systematically create and test material people want to share: unusual HVAC and electrical problems, breakdowns of bad installations, contractor and homeowner mistakes, myths, equipment comparisons, experiments, answers to common questions. Nobody can guarantee every video goes viral — the job is systematic work on ideas with high reach potential.



Our content must be different. Thousands of contractors publish the same thing: "Call us for all your HVAC needs." We do not need that. The constant question: why would someone watch our content? It must be original, useful, easy for a homeowner to understand, visually recognizable, and interesting even to someone who is not buying anything right now. The goal is our own media style and brand voice.



6. AI AS A WORKING TOOL



Professional use of modern AI tools for research and competitor analysis, copywriting, image and video generation, editing, AI avatars and voice-over, scripts, creatives, landing pages, SEO analysis, content repurposing, analytics, and automation. AI makes production faster and cheaper, but it does not replace strategic thinking, originality, fact-checking, or responsibility for results.



7. ANALYTICS AND FULL-FUNNEL RESPONSIBILITY



The manager owns the entire customer journey:



>> Strategy → Attention → Lead → Appointment → Customer → Sale → Payment → Collected Revenue



To do this, they build and maintain attribution: CRM, call tracking, unique phone numbers, conversion and website tracking, Google Analytics, tracking across Google Ads, GBP, Yelp, Meta, YouTube, and landing pages. The company must know the source of every customer.



A report like "Google Ads generated 100 leads" is not enough. We want to see:



>> Marketing Spend → Leads → Qualified Leads → Appointments → Customers → Sales → Collected Revenue → Profit



If there are leads but no customers, the manager finds exactly where the funnel breaks (traffic quality, offer, website, response time, call handling, qualification, scheduling, sales, pricing, follow-up) and proposes a measurable solution.



============================================================

KPI

============================================================



New and qualified leads, new customers, CPL, CAC, Lead → Customer conversion rate, jobs sold, average ticket, collected revenue, ROAS, Marketing ROI, profitability, organic acquisition growth.



The number of posts, videos, views, impressions, and clicks is not the final result.



On ROAS: $10,000 in advertising → $50,000 in collected revenue = ROAS 5x. But ROAS alone does not equal profit. The manager accounts for job costs, gross margin, CAC, refunds, chargebacks, and all marketing expenses. The goal is not an impressive number, but profitable growth.



============================================================

COMPENSATION

============================================================



The primary model is a percentage of revenue actually collected by the company from new customers that can be objectively attributed to marketing channels created or managed by the Growth Marketing Manager. There is no income cap: the company earns more → the manager earns more.



Commission is paid only on money the company has actually received. Not included: unsigned and unpaid estimates, unpaid invoices, canceled jobs, refunds and chargebacks, existing customers without a confirmed new source, personal referrals outside the marketing system, repeat business (unless separately agreed).



Customer source is confirmed through CRM, call tracking, unique phone numbers, website tracking, platforms (Google Ads, GBP, Yelp, Meta, YouTube), landing pages, and other pre-agreed attribution systems.



============================================================

PROOF OF EXPERIENCE

============================================================



During selection, the candidate must show real projects with numbers: what business, the starting situation, budget, number of leads and customers, CPL, CAC, ROAS, collected revenue, which organic channels were built, what did not work and why, and what the candidate did personally.



"I increased brand awareness" and "I managed social media" are not proof of experience. The format: Problem → Action → Numbers → Result.



============================================================

WHO THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR

============================================================



Anyone who measures success by the number of posts, clicks, and impressions; solves every problem by increasing the budget; does not work with analytics; waits for instructions and avoids decisions; is not ready to own a measurable result; does not use AI professionally; produces the same generic content as every other contractor; cannot explain how their work turns into customers, revenue, and profit.



============================================================

CORE PRINCIPLE

============================================================



The Growth Marketing Manager can answer at any moment: how much we spent, how many qualified leads and new customers we got, what one customer cost, how much revenue they brought, which channels are profitable, what to scale, what to shut down — and how to get more customers without proportionally increasing the budget.



The job is to build a marketing system that over time becomes stronger, more recognizable, more organic, cheaper, and more profitable.



The ultimate result: the maximum number of profitable customers with the minimum necessary marketing budget.

Your main responsibility is simple:



Make sure every customer request and every active project keeps moving forward without the owner having to constantly call people, chase information, or remind you what needs to be done.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Managing incoming customer requests and active jobs

* Scheduling service calls, installations, follow-up visits, and inspections

* Managing and updating the company calendar

* Communicating with customers by phone, text, and email

* Confirming appointments and arrival windows

* Rescheduling appointments when necessary

* Following up with customers regarding estimates, approvals, scheduling, and project status

* Answering customer questions related to scheduling and project coordination

* Handling routine customer concerns and finding solutions

* Keeping customers informed when schedules, equipment deliveries, or project timelines change

* Calling suppliers and distributors

* Checking equipment and material availability

* Requesting pricing and order information

* Collecting missing information, photos, documents, model numbers, or other project details

* Updating job notes and customer information in the CRM

* Making sure no customer request or project is forgotten or left without a next action



What We Expect



We are looking for someone who does not wait to be told every individual step.



For example:



If equipment is expected to arrive tomorrow, you should check the status before the installation.



If the supplier says the equipment is delayed, you should determine the new ETA, communicate with the customer, coordinate with the field team, adjust the schedule if necessary, and update the CRM.



The owner should not have to ask:

You should already know what needs to be followed up on.



Required Skills



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to manage many jobs and conversations at the same time

* Construction

* Home services

* Property management

* Service dispatching

* Project coordination

* Construction administration

* Customer service for U.S. companies

Work Schedule



Full-time remote position.

You must be comfortable working those hours consistently.



Compensation



Starting compensation depends on experience.



Expected starting range:



$4–$6 USD per hour



Strong performers who demonstrate independence, reliability, excellent customer communication, and the ability to manage projects with minimal supervision can earn more.



Who Will Be Successful in This Position



You may be a good fit if you are the type of person who:



* notices problems before someone points them out;

* likes keeping things organized;

* follows up until an issue is actually resolved;

* is comfortable calling people instead of waiting for email replies;

* does not forget unfinished tasks;

* takes ownership of responsibilities;

* can communicate professionally with demanding customers;

* stays calm when schedules change;

* can determine what needs to happen next without waiting for detailed instructions.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of the team, not someone looking for a temporary side job.



How to Apply

4. Any experience with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber, or similar software.

title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
description:
Influencer Marketing Specialist

Location: Philippines / Remote

Employment Type: Full-time



Job Overview:

We are looking for an Influencer Marketing Specialist to support our influencer marketing and KOL partnership initiatives. This role will be responsible for identifying suitable influencers, managing outreach, coordinating content production, reviewing campaign performance, and helping build a sustainable influencer resource pool for our platform.

We are open to both execution-level and more experienced candidates. Candidates with small team management experience or the ability to lead influencer marketing projects independently will be highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

1. Influencer Research & Resource Development

- Independently search for and identify suitable influencers/KOLs based on our platform’s business needs, target audience, and campaign goals.

- Cover major social media platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and
.

- Build and maintain an influencer database, including account information, content style, audience profile, engagement rate, pricing, cooperation history, and contact status.

2. Outreach & Partnership Communication

- Clearly introduce our platform, cooperation model, campaign goals, and content requirements to potential influencers.

- Manage influencer outreach, follow-ups, initial negotiation, cooperation confirmation, and ongoing communication.

- Maintain a professional and friendly communication style to build long-term influencer relationships.

3. Content Production Coordination

- Prepare or assist in preparing campaign briefs, including content direction, key selling points, posting requirements, timelines, and important notes.

- Coordinate with influencers throughout the content production process, including script review, draft feedback, revision follow-up, and final publishing.

- Review influencer content to ensure it aligns with the platform’s positioning, brand tone, campaign goals, and basic quality standards.

- Provide reasonable feedback to improve content quality, clarity, engagement, and conversion potential.

4. Campaign Execution & Project Follow-up

- Follow up on the full influencer cooperation process, from influencer sourcing and outreach to content publishing and data collection.

- Track cooperation progress, identify issues in time, and coordinate with internal teams when needed.

- Help improve influencer cooperation workflows, outreach templates, campaign briefs, and tracking documents.

5. Data Collection & Campaign Review

- Collect and organize campaign performance data, including views, reach, engagement, clicks, registrations, downloads, conversions, and other relevant metrics.

- Analyze the performance of different influencers, content formats, platforms, and campaign strategies.

- Prepare regular campaign summaries and provide suggestions for future optimization.

- Support decisions on whether to continue, renew, or expand cooperation with specific influencers.

6. Content & Social Media Trend Observation

- Stay updated on content trends across major social media platforms, especially in European, North American markets.

- Understand popular content formats, creator styles, and influencer marketing approaches.

- Suggest suitable influencer cooperation directions and content ideas based on platform goals.

- Candidates with social media operation experience may also support basic content planning or promotional content optimization.

7. Team Coordination / Small Team Management, If Applicable

- For more experienced candidates, assist in coordinating influencer marketing tasks within a small team.

- Support task allocation, progress tracking, quality review, and performance follow-up for junior team members or supporting staff.

- Help establish clearer workflow standards, communication templates, resource management methods, and campaign review mechanisms.



Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, English, or a related field.

2. Experience in Influencer Marketing, KOL Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Affiliate Marketing, or overseas marketing is preferred.

3. Familiarity with major social media platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and
.

4. Experience managing the full influencer cooperation process, including influencer sourcing, outreach, communication, content coordination, publishing follow-up, and data review.

5. Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally with influencers in Europe and North America.

6. Strong communication, execution, and project follow-up skills.

7. Basic data organization and analysis skills, with the ability to track cooperation progress and summarize campaign performance clearly.

8. Good judgment of content quality, brand tone, and user experience.
